6\. He is the knower of the Vedangas,3 the lord of the Vedas, mine of strength and the aggrandiser of the strong. He is without changes, the lord of boons, the giver of boons, and the master of Varuna.

## \|\| 15.7 \|\|

*vīrahā ca bṛhadvīro vanditaḥ parameśvaraḥ (30) \|*  
*ātmā ca paramātmā ca pratyagātmā viyatparaḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. He is the slayer of heroes, the great hero and the great Isvara adored of all. He is the soul, the great soul, the inward self and above the sky.

## \|\| 15.8 \|\|

*padmanābhaḥ padmanidhiḥ padmahasto gadādharaḥ \|*  
*paramaḥ (40)parabhūtaśca puruṣottama īśvaraḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. He is lotus-navelled, the Padmaniddhi,4 the lotus-handed and the holder of club. He is the great, above the elements, the foremost Purusa and the Demiurgus.

## \|\| 15.9 \|\|

*padmajaṅghaḥ puṇḍarīkaḥ padmamālādharaḥ priyaḥ \|*  
*padmākṣaḥ padmagarbhaśca parjanyaḥ (50)padmasaṃsthitaḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. He is lotus-waisted, Pundarika wears a garland oflotuses and is beloved of all. He is lotus eyed, Padmagarbha,\* 1 Parjanya (rain-god) and seated on a lotus.

## \|\| 15.10 \|\|

*apāraḥ paramārthaśca parāṇāṃ ca paraḥ prabhuḥ \|*  
*paṇḍitaḥ paṇḍiteḍyaśca pavitraḥ pāpamardakaḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. He is beyond the range of all, the great object, the greatest of the great lord. He is most learned of all learned men, holy and destroyer of sins.

## \|\| 15.11 \|\|

*śuddhaḥ (60)prakāśarūpaśca pavitraḥ parirakṣakaḥ \|*  
*pipāsāvarjitaḥ pādyaḥ puruṣaḥ prakṛtistathāḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. He is pure, manifests all, holy and the protector. He is devoid of thirdstt, Padya,2 the Purusa and Prakrti (Nature).

## \|\| 15.12-13 \|\|

*pradhānaṃ pṛthivīpadmaṃ padmanābhaḥ (70)priyapradaḥ \|*  
*sarveśaḥ sarvagaḥ sarvaḥ sarvavitsarvadaḥ suraḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

*sarvasya jagato dhāma sarvadarśo ca sarvabhṛt (80) \|*  
*sarvānugrahakṛddevaḥ sarvabhūtahṛdi sthitaḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

12-13. Не is Pradhana (intellectual principle), the lotus, the earth, the lotus-navelled and the given of desirable objects. He is the lord of all, present every where, the All, Omniscient, the giver of all and the great. He is identical with all and the entire universe, the witness and up-holder of all. He is the Deity who shows favour unto all and is stationed in the hearts of all creatures.

## \|\| 15.14 \|\|

*sarvapūjyaśca sarvādyaḥ sarvadevanamaskṛtaḥ \|*  
*sarvasya jagato mūlaṃ sakalo niṣkalo 'nalaḥ (90) \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. He is the protector of all, is adored of all and is saluted hy all the deities. He is at the root of the entire universe, is the destroyer of all and the fire.

## \|\| 15.15 \|\|

*sarvagoptā sarvaniṣṭhaḥ sarvakāraṇakāraṇam \|*  
*sarvadhyeyaḥ sarvamitraḥ sarvadesvavarūpadhṛk \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. He is protector of all, pervaded all and the cause of all causes. He is meditated on by all the friend of all and the holder of the various forms of the deities.

## \|\| 15.16 \|\|

*sarvādhyakṣaḥ surādhyakṣa surāsuranamaskṛtaḥ \|*  
*duṣṭānāṃ ca surāṇāṃ ca sarvadā ghātako 'ntakaḥ (101) \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. He is the object of the study of all, the commander of the celestials and is adored of the gods and Asuras.. He is always the destroyer of the wicked and Asuras.

## \|\| 15.17 \|\|

*satyapālaśca sannābhaḥ siddheśaḥ siddhavanditaḥ \|*  
*siddhasādhyaḥ siddhasiddhaḥ sādhyasiddho (siddhisiddha) hṛdīśvaraḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. He is the procector of truth, the centre of good people, the lord of Siddhas, is adored by them, is obtained by the Siddhas and the Sadhyas and the lord of their hearts.

## \|\| 15.18 \|\|

*śaraṇaṃ jagataścaiva (110)śreyaḥ kṣemastathaiva ca \|*  
*śubhakṛcchobhanaḥ saumyaḥ satyaḥ satyaparākramaḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. He is the refuge of the world, the auspiciousness, the doer of good, beautiful, humble, trurh, of a true determination, the knower and giver of truth.

## \|\| 15.19 \|\|

*satyasthaḥ satyasaṅkalpaḥ satyavitsatya (tpa) dastathā (121) \|*  
*dharmo dharṃmo ca karmo ca sarvakarṃmavivarjitaḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. He is religion, the observer of religious rites and a Karmin (one who practises religious rites) but he is devoid of all actions.

## \|\| 15.20 \|\|

*karṃmakartā ca karmaiva kriyā kāryaṃ tathaiva ca \|*  
*śrīpatirnṛpatiḥ (131)śrīmānsarvasya patirūrjitaḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. He is the orgainer of actions, the action itself and the practice of religious rites. He is the lord of Sri and of men, beautiful, he lord of all, but himself having no master.

## \|\| 15.21 \|\|

*sadevānāṃ patiścaiva vṛṣṇīnāṃ patirīḍitaḥ \|*  
*patirhiraṇyagarbhasya tripurāntapatistathā \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. He is the lord of the celestials, the master of Vrsnis, of Hiranyagarbha and of the destroyer of Tripura.

## \|\| 15.22-25 \|\|

*paśūnāṃ ca patiḥ prāyo vasūnāṃ patireva ca (140) \|*  
*patirākhaṇḍalasyaiva varūṇasya patistathā \|\| 22 \|\|*

*vanaspatīnāṃ ca patiranilasya patistathā \|*  
*analasya patiścaiva yamasya patireva ca \|\| 23 \|\|*

*kuberasya patiścaiva nakṣatrāṇāṃ patistathā \|*  
*oṣadhīnāṃ patiścaiva vṛkṣāṇāṃ ca patistathā (150) \|\| 24 \|\|*

*nāgānāṃ patirarkasya dakṣasya patireva ca \|*  
*suhṛdāṃ ca patiścaiva nṛpāṇāṃ ca patistathā \|\| 25 \|\|*

22-25. He is the lord of the beasts, Vasus, Indra, Varuna, trees, wind, fire, Yama, Kubera, stars, Medicinal herbs and trees. He is the master of the Nagas, of the sun, of Dakasa, of friends and of kings.

## \|\| 15.26 \|\|

*gandharvāṇāṃ patiścaiva asūnāṃ patiruttamaḥ \|*  
*parvatānāṃ patiścaiva nimnagānāṃ patistathā \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. He is the master of me Gandharavas, me most excellent lord of the Asuras, of the mountains and rivers.

## \|\| 15.27 \|\|

*surāṇāṃ ca patiḥ śreṣṭhaḥ (160) kapilasya patistathā \|*  
*latānāṃ ca patiścaiva vīrudhāṃ ca patistathā \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. He is the most powerful lord of the celestials, of Kapila, of creepers and of VIrudhas (spreading, creeper

## \|\| 15.28 \|\|

*munīnāṃ ca patiścaiva sūryasya patiruttamaḥ \|*  
*patiścandramasaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ sukrasya patireva ca \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. He is the master of the asceties, the most excellent lord of the sun, moon, and of Sukra.

## \|\| 15.29 \|\|

*grahāṇāṃ ca patiścaiva rākṣasānāṃ patistathā \|*  
*kinnarāṇāṃ patiścaiva (170)dvijānāṃ patiruttamaḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. He is the lord of planets, Raksases, the Kinnaras and the most excellent master of the twice-born ones.

## \|\| 15.30 \|\|

*saritāṃ ca patiścaiva samudrāṇāṃ patistathā \|*  
*sarasāṃ ca patiścaiva bhūtānāṃ ca patistathā \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. He is the lord of the rivers, oceans, lakes and goblins.

## \|\| 15.31 \|\|

*vetālānāṃ patiścaiva kūṣmāṇḍānāṃ patistathā \|*  
*pakṣiṇāṃ ca patiḥ śreṣṭhaḥ paśūnāṃ patireva ca \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. He is the master of the Vetalas, Kusmandas, birds and breasts.

## \|\| 15.32 \|\|

*mahātmā (180)maṅgalo meyo mandaro mandareśvaraḥ \|*  
*merurmātā pramāṇaṃ ca mādhavo malavarjitaḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. He is the high-souled Maligala, Mandara, the lord of Mandara. He is creator of Meru and Madhava and devoid of mind.

## \|\| 15.33 \|\|

*mālādharo (190)mahādevo mahādevena pūjitaḥ \|*  
*mahāśānto mahābhāgo madhusūdana eva ca \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. The great deity wears a garland and is adored by Mahadeva. He is of a quiescent soul, and is tile illustrious slayer of Madhu.

## \|\| 15.34 \|\|

*mahāvīryo mahāprāṇo mārkaṇḍeyarṣivanditaḥ(200) \|*  
*māyātmā māyayā baddho māyayā tu vivarjitaḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. He is highly powerful, the great vital air and is lauded by Markandeya. He is identical with Maya (illusion), feuered by it and devoid of it.

## \|\| 15.35 \|\|

*munistuto munirmaitro (210)mahānā (rā) so mahāhanuḥ \|*  
*mahābāhurmahādānto maraṇena vivarjitaḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. He is landed by the ascetics and is their friend. He has a nose, big cheeks, big anus, big teeth and is freed from death.

## \|\| 15.36 \|\|

*mahāvatkkro mahātmā ca mahākāyo mahodaraḥ \|*  
*mahāpādo mahāgrīvo mahāmānī mahāmanāḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. He has a huge moutll, a great soul, a great body, a great belly, big feet and a high neck.

## \|\| 15.37 \|\|

*mahāgatirmaṃhākīrtirmahārūpo (222)mahāsuraḥ \|*  
*madhuśca mādhavaścaiva mahādevo maheśvaraḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. He is greatly respected, is high-minded, of - great intellect, of great fame, of great form and the great Asura. He is Madhu, he is Madhava, he is Mahadeva, and he is Mahesvasra.

## \|\| 15.38 \|\|

*makhejyo makharūpī ca mānanīyo (230)makheśvaraḥ \|*  
*mahāvāto mahābhāgo maheśo 'tītamānuṣaḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. Не is adored in sacrifices, of the form of a sacrifies and is the worshipped lord of the sacrifices. He is the great wind, the great luck and the superhuman Mahesa.

## \|\| 15.39 \|\|

*mānavaśca manuścaiva mānavānāṃ priyaṅkaraḥ \|*  
*mṛgaśca mṛgapūjyaśca (240)mṛgāṇāṃ ca patistathā \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. He is man, Manu and does good unto men. He is deer, is adored by them tand is their lord.

## \|\| 15.40 \|\|

*budhasya ca patiścaiva patiścaiva bṛhaspateḥ \|*  
*patiḥ śanaiścarasyaiva rāhoḥ ketoḥ patistathā \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. He is the master of Mercury, Venus, Saturn, Rahu and Ketu.

## \|\| 15.41 \|\|

*lakṣmaṇo lakṣaṇaścaiva lambauṣṭho lalitastathā(250) \|*  
*nānālaṅkārasaṃyukto nānācandanacarcitaḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. He is the good mark and is endued with it; he has long lips anti is handsome to look at. He is bedecked with various ornaments and besmeared with sandal of different kinds.

## \|\| 15.42 \|\|

*nānārasojjavaladvakkro nānāpuṣpopaśobhitaḥ \|*  
*rāmo ramāpatiścaiva sabhāryaḥ parameśvaraḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. His face is painted effulgent, with various colours-and adorned with diverse flowers. He is Rama, the great Isvara with his consort.

## \|\| 15.43 \|\|

*ratnado ratnahartā ca(260)rūpī rūpavivarjitaḥ \|*  
*mahārūpograrūpaśca saumyarūpastathaiva ca \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. He gives jewels and lakes them away. He is with and without any boon. He is of a great, terrific and calm appearance.

## \|\| 15.44 \|\|

*nīlameghanibhaḥ śuddhaḥ sālameghanibhastathā \|*  
*dhūmavarṇaḥ pativarṇo nānārūpo(270)hyavarṇakaḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. He is like unto a blue cloud, is pure and resembles a cloud at the end of a cycle. He is smoky cloud, of yellow hue, of various forms and without any colour.

## \|\| 15.45 \|\|

*virūpo rūpadaścaiva śuklavarṇastathaiva ca \|*  
*sarvavarṇo mahāyogī yajño (yājyo) yajñakṛdeva ca \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. He is of a distorted figure, the giver of forms and is, white hued. He is of all colours, the great yogin, the sacrificer.

## \|\| 15.46 \|\|

*suvarṇavarṇavāṃścaiva suvarṇākhyastathaiva ca (280)suvarṇāvayavaścaiva suvarṇaḥ svarṇamekhalaḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. He is gold-hued and is called gold. His body is made of gold and he puts on a golden girdle.

## \|\| 15.47 \|\|

*suvarṇasya pradātā ca suvarṇeśastathaiva ca \|*  
*suvarṇasya priyaścaiva (290)suvarṇāḍhyastathaiva ca \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. He is the giver of gold or parts of it. He is fond of gold and houses made of gold.

## \|\| 15.48 \|\|

*suparṇo ca mahāparṇo suparṇasya ca kāraṇ(290) \|*  
*vainateyastathāditya ādirādikaraḥ śivaḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. He is beautiful and of huge wings and the creator of Suparna. He is Vinata's son, the son, the beginning, the the creator of beginning and auspiciousness.

## \|\| 15.49 \|\|

*kāraṇaṃ mahataścaiva pradhānasya ca kāraṇam \|*  
*buddhīnāṃ kāraṇaṃ caiva kāraṇaṃ manasastathā \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. Не is the cause of the intellectual principle, of the Puranas, of intellect and mind.

## \|\| 15.50-51 \|\|

*kāraṇaṃ caitasaścaiva(300)ahaṅkārasya kāraṇam \|*  
*bhūtānāṃ kāraṇaṃ tadvatkāraṇaṃ ca vibhāvasoḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

*ākāśakāraṇaṃ tadvatpṛthivyāḥ kāraṇaṃ param \|*  
*aṇḍasya kāraṇaṃ caiva prakṛteḥ kāraṇaṃ tathā \|\| 51 \|\|*

50-51. Не is the efficient cause of consciousness, egoism, elements of fire, ether, earth, egg and Prakrti (Nature).

## \|\| 15.52-55 \|\|

*dehasya kāraṇaṃ caiva cakṣuṣaścaiva kāraṇam \|*  
*śrotrasya kāraṇaṃ(310) tadvatkāraṇaṃ ca tvacastathā \|\| 52 \|\|*

*jihvāyāḥ kāraṇaṃ caiva prāṇasyaiva ca kāraṇam \|*  
*hastayoḥ kāraṇaṃ tadvatpādayoḥ kāraṇaṃ tathā \|\| 53 \|\|*

*vācaścakāraṇaṃ tadvatpāyoścaiva tukāraṇam \|*  
*indrasya kāraṇaṃ caiva kuberasya ca kāraṇam \|\| 54 \|\|*

*yamasya kāraṇaṃ caiva (320)īśānasya ca kāraṇam \|*  
*yakṣāṇāṃ kāraṇaṃ caiva rakṣasāṃ kāraṇaṃ param \|\| 55 \|\|*

52-55. He is the cause of the body, eyes, ears, skin, tongue, vital breath, hand, foot, speech and the organ of generation. He is the efficient cause of Indra, Kubera, Yama, Isana and the most excellent creator of Yaksa and Raksasas.

## \|\| 15.56-58 \|\|

*nṛpāṇāṃ kāraṇaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ dharṃmasyaiva tu kāraṇam \|*  
*jantūnāṃ kāraṇaṃ caiva vasūnāṃ kāraṇaṃ param \|\| 56 \|\|*

*manūnāṃ kāraṇaṃ caiva pakṣiṇāṃ kāraṇaṃ param \|*  
*munīnāṃ kāraṇaṃ śreṣṭha(330)yogināṃ kāraṇaṃ param \|\| 57 \|\|*

*siddhānāṃ kāraṇaṃ caiva yakṣāṇāṃ kāraṇaṃ param \|*  
*kāraṇaṃ kinnarāṇāṃ ca(340) gandharvāṇāṃ ca kāraṇam \|\| 58 \|\|*

56-58. Не is the most excellent cause of ornaments, virtue, creatures, Vasus (gods of riches), of Manus and of birds. He is the foremost cause of the asceticism the Yogins, the Siddhas, the Yaksas, the Kinnaras and Gandharvas.

## \|\| 15.59-60 \|\|

*nadānāṃ kāraṇaṃ caiva nadīnāṃ kāraṇaṃ param \|*  
*kāraṇaṃ ca samudrāṇāṃ vṛkṣāṇāṃ kāraṇaṃ tathā \|\| 59 \|\|*

*kāraṇaṃ vīrudhāṃ caiva lokānāṃ kāraṇaṃ tathā \|*  
*pātāla kāraṇaṃ caiva devānāṃ kāraṇaṃ tathā \|\| 60 \|\|*

59-60. Не is the cause of the river, male and female, the oceans and trees. He is the cause of Virudhas, the worlds, the nether region and celestials.

## \|\| 15.61 \|\|

*sarpāṇāṃ kāraṇaṃ caiva(350)śreyasāṃ kāraṇaṃ tathā \|*  
*pūśanāṃ kāraṇaṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ kāraṇaṃ tathā \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. He is the cause of serpents, the auspiciousness, the beasts and of all.

## \|\| 15.62-66 \|\|

*dehātmā cendriyātmā ca ātmā buddhistathaiva ca \|*  
*manasaśca tathaivātmā cātmāhaṅkāracetasaḥ \|\| 62 \|\|*

*jāgrataḥ svapataścātmā (360)mahadātmā parastathā \|*  
*pradhānasya parātmā ca ākāśātmā hyapāṃ tathā \|\| 63 \|\|*

*pṛthivyāḥ paramātmā ca rasasyātmā tathaiva ca \|*  
*gandhasya paramātmā ca rūpasyātmā parastathā \|\| 64 \|\|*

*śabdātmā caiva (370)vāgātmā sparśātmā puruṣastathā \|*  
*śrotrātmā ca tvagātmā ca jihvāyāḥ paramastathā \|\| 65 \|\|*

*ghrāṇātmā caiva hastātmā pādātmā paramastathā(380) \|*  
*upasthasya tathaivātmā pāyvātmā paramastathā \|\| 66 \|\|*

62-66. He is identical with the body, the organs of sense, the soul, the intellect, the mind, egoism, consciousness, the condition of waking, that of dreaming sleep, the intellectual principle and the great soul. He is identical with ether, water, and the great soul of earth and air. Не is the great soul of the smell, colour, sound, speech and touch. He permeates, as the great soul, the ears, skin, tongue, nostrils, hand, foot, organ of generation.

## \|\| 15.67 \|\|

*indrātmā caiva brahmātmā rudrā(śāntā)tmā ca manostathā \|*  
*dakṣaprajāpaterātmā satyā (sraṣṭā)tmā paramastathā \|\| 67 \|\|*

67\. Не permeates Indra, Brahma, Rudra, Manu, anu the Patriarch Daksa. The great is identical with truth.

## \|\| 15.68-70 \|\|

*īśātmā(390)paramātmā ca raudrātmā mokṣavidyatiḥ \|*  
*yatnavāṃśca tathā yatnaścarṃmo khaḍgī murāntakaḥ \|\| 68 \|\|*

*hrīpravartanaśīlaśca yatīnāṃ ca hite rataḥ \|*  
*yatirūpī ca (400)yogī ca yogidhyeyo hariḥ śitiḥ \|\| 69 \|\|*

*saṃvinmedhā ca kālaśca ūṣmā varṣā ma(na) tistathā(410) \|*  
*saṃvatsaro mokṣakaro mohapradhvaṃsakastathā \|\| 70 \|\|*

68-70. He is identical with Isa, the great soul, the Rudra and the Yati conversant with the knowledge of emancipation. He is energetic and is the very energy itself. He is the holder of the leathern fence and sword and the destroyer of the Asuras. He is modest by nature and engaged in the well-being of the acetics. Hari is of the form of a Yatin, a Yogin and is meditated on by the Yogins. He is ЙШ1. He is perfect knowledge, genius, time, summer, rainy season, determination, year, the ordainer of emancipation and destroyer of Moha-(stupifac- tion).

## \|\| 15.71-73 \|\|

*mohakartā ca duṣṭānāṃ māṇḍavyo vaḍavāmukhaḥ \|*  
*saṃvartaḥ kālakartā ca gautamo bhṛguraṅgirāḥ (420) \|\| 71 \|\|*

*atnirvasiṣṭhaḥ pulahaḥ pulastyaḥ kutsa eva ca \|*  
*yājñavalkyo devalaśca vyāsaścaiva parāśaraḥ \|\| 72 \|\|*

*śarṃmadaścaiva(430) gāṅgeyo hṛṣīkeśo bṛhacchravāḥ \|*  
*keśavaḥ kleśahantā ca sukarṇaḥ karṇavarjitaḥ \|\| 73 \|\|*

71-73. He stupefies the wicked, is Mandavya and mare-mouthed. He is Sangvartaka (fire), the creator of time, Goutama, Bhrgu, Angira, Atri, Vasistha, Pulaha, Pulastya, Kutsa, Yajnavalkya, Devala, Vyasa, Parasara, Narmada, Gangeya, Hrsikesa, Vrhatsrava and Kesava. He is the destroyer of miseries, has beautiful ears and is without them.

## \|\| 15.74-75 \|\|

*nārāyaṇo mahābhāgaḥ prāṇasya patireva ca (440) \|*  
*apānasya patiścaiva vyānasya patireva ca \|\| 74 \|\|*

*udānasya patiḥ śreṣṭhaḥ samānasya patistathā \|*  
*śabdasya ca patiḥ śreṣṭhaḥ sparśasya patireva ca \|\| 75 \|\|*

74-75. The great Narayana is the lord of Prana, of vital air the Apana, of Vyana, of Udana and of Samana. He is the best master of sound, touch and colour.

## \|\| 15.76 \|\|

*rūpāṇāṃ ca patiścādyaḥ khaṅgapāṇir halāyudhaḥ(450) \|*  
*cakrapāṇiḥ kuṇḍalī ca śrīvatsāṃkastathaiva ca \|\| 76 \|\|*

76\. He is the master of the destruction of the world, the first-born, has a sword in his hand, the plough-share for his weapon, the discus in his hand, the Kundalas \[on his ears\] and the mystic mark Srivatsa on his breast.

## \|\| 15.77 \|\|

*prakṛtiḥ kaustubhagrīvaḥ pītāmbaradharastathā \|*  
*sumukho durmukhaścaiva munakhena tu vivarjitaḥ \|\| 77 \|\|*

77\. He is Prakrti, has the Koustubbha gem on his neck and is clad in a yellow raiment. He has a beautiful face, an ugly face and is without any.

## \|\| 15.78 \|\|

*ananto 'nantarūpaśca(461)sunakhaḥ suramandaraḥ \|*  
*sukapolo vibhurjiṣṇurbhrājiṣṇuścaiṣudhīstathā \|\| 78 \|\|*

78\. He is without end, of endless froms, has beautiful nails and is the handsoment of all the celestials. The lord Visnu has a beautiful quiver and most resplendent arrows.

## \|\| 15.79 \|\|

*hiraṇyakaśiporhantā hiraṇyākṣavimardakaḥ (470) \|*  
*nihantā pūtanāyāśca bhāskarāntavināśanaḥ \|\| 79 \|\|*

79\. He is the destroyer of Hiranyakasipu, the grinder of Hiranyak$a, the killer of Putana and Bhaskaranata.

## \|\| 15.80-81 \|\|

*keśino dalanaścaiva muṣṭikasya vimardakaḥ \|*  
*kaṃsadānavabhettā ca cāṇūrasya pramardakaḥ \|\| 80 \|\|*

*ariṣṭasya nihantā ca akrūrapriya eva ca \|*  
*akrūraḥ krūrarūpaśca(480)akrūrapriyavanditaḥ \|\| 81 \|\|*

80-81. He is the grinder of Kegin, and Mustika. He is the killer of the demon Kansa, of Canura and Arista. He is fond of Akmra. He is without wickedness, is wily and is adored by those who are fond of simplicity.

## \|\| 15.82 \|\|

*bhagahā bhagavān bhānustathā bhāgavataḥ svagavataḥ svayam \|*  
*uddhavaścoddhavasyeśo hyuddhevana vicintitaḥ \|\| 82 \|\|*

82\. He is the destroyer of the lordly powers, is himself endued with them, the sun and the Lord himself. He is Uddhava's lord, and is being meditated on by Uddhava.

## \|\| 15.83-84 \|\|

*cakradhṛk cañcalaścaiva(490) calācalavivarjitaḥ \|*  
*ahaṃ kāropamāścittaṃ gaganaṃ pṛthivī jalam \|\| 83 \|\|*

*vāyuścakṣustathā śrotraṃ(500)jihvā ca ghrāṇameva ca \|*  
*vākpāṇipādajavanaḥ pāyūpasthastathaiva ca \|\| 84 \|\|*

83-84. He is the holder of discus, is fickle and is devoid of the moveable and immoveable properties. He is egoism, determination, mental faculties, the sky, earth, water, air, eye, ear, tongue, nose, palate, hand, foot, waist and the organ of generation.

## \|\| 15.85-86 \|\|

*śaṅkaraścaiva sarvaśca kṣāntidaḥ kṣāntikṛnnaraḥ (511) \|*  
*bhaktapriyastatā bhartā bhaktimān bhaktivardhanaḥ \|\| 85 \|\|*

*bhaktastuto bhaktaparaḥ kīrtidaḥ kīrtivardhanaḥ \|*  
*kīrtirdeptiḥ (520) kṣamākāntirbhaktaścaiva (530) dayā parā \|\| 86 \|\|*

85-86. He is Sankara, the giver of auspiciousness, the giver of endurance; and he forgives men. He is fond of his votaries and is their protector. He is endued with reverential faith and himself increases it. He is lauded by his votaries, devoted to them and gives fame; and he multiplies it.

## \|\| 15.87 \|\|

*dānaṃ dātā ca kartā ca devadevapriyaḥ śuciḥ \|*  
*śucimā nsukhado (531)mokṣaḥ kāmaścārthaḥ sahasrapāt \|\| 87 \|\|*

87\. He is fame, resplendence, forgiveness, patience, reverential faith, compassion, the great, the gift, the giver, the agent of action, is fond of the celestials, is purity, is pure, the giver of felicity, emancipation and the object of desire. He has a thousand feet.

## \|\| 15.88 \|\|

*sahasraśīrṣā vaidyaśca mokṣadvāraṃ tathaiva ca \|*  
*prajādvāraṃ sahasrākṣaḥ sahasrakara eva ca(540) \|\| 88 \|\|*

88\. He is the thousand-headed physician who opens the gate of emancipation. He is the door of subjects, has a thousand ends and a thousand hands.

## \|\| 15.89-90 \|\|

*śukraśca sukirīṭī ca sugrīvaḥ kaustubhastathā \|*  
*pradyumnaścāniruddhaśca hayagrīvaśca sūkaraḥ \|\| 89 \|\|*

*matsyaḥ paraśurāmaśca(550)prahrādo balirevaca \|*  
*śaraṇyaścaiva nityaśca buddho muktaḥ śarīrabhṛt \|\| 90 \|\|*

89-90. He is 6ukra, has a beautiful head-gear, and a beautiful neck. He is Kesava, Pradyumna, Aniruddha, Hayagriva, Shukara (boar), Matysa (fish), Parasurama, Prahlada and Bali. He is daily sought by people for help, enlightened, emancipated and the holder of forms.

## \|\| 15.91 \|\|

*kharadūṣaṇahantā ca rāvaṇasya pramardanaḥ \|*  
*sītāpatiśca (560)vardhiṣṇurbharataśca tathaiva ca \|\| 91 \|\|*

91\. He is the destroyer of Khara and Dusana and the grinder of Ravana. He is the husband of Sita and the prosperous Bharata.

## \|\| 15.92 \|\|

*kumbhendrajinnihantā ca kumbhakarṇapramardanaḥ \|*  
*narāntakāntakaścaiva devāntakavināśanaḥ \|\| 92 \|\|*

92\. He is the killer of the voctor of Kumbh- endra, the grinder of Kumbhakarna, the destroyer of the killers of men and celestials.

## \|\| 15.93 \|\|

*duṣṭāsuranihantā ca śambarāristathaiva ca \|*  
*narakasya nihantā ca triśīrṣasya vināśanaḥ (570) \|\| 93 \|\|*

93\. He is the destroyer of the wicked Asuras and the enemy of Shambara, He is the destroyer of (the demon) Naraka as well as of the threee- headed demon.

## \|\| 15.94 \|\|

*yamalārjanabhettā ca tapohitakarastathā \|*  
*vāditraṃ caiva vādyaṃ ca buddhaścaiva varapradaḥ \|\| 94 \|\|*

94\. He broke down \[the trees\] Yamala and Arjuna and always helps asceticism. He plays on the musical instrument and is himself the instrument. He is enlightened and the giver of boons.

## \|\| 15.95 \|\|

*sāraḥ sārapriyaḥ sauraḥ kālahantṛnikṛntanaḥ(580) \|*  
*agastyo devalaścaiva nārado nāradapriyaḥ \|\| 95 \|\|*

95\. Не is substance and is fond of substances. He is Soura and the destroyer of time and is incapable of being cut. He is Agastya, Devala, Narada, the fond of Narada.

## \|\| 15.96 \|\|

*prāṇo 'pānastathā vyāno rajaḥ sattvaṃ tamaḥ (590)śarat \|*  
*udānaśca samānaśca bheṣajaṃ ca bhiṣak tathā \|\| 96 \|\|*

96\. Не is Prana, Арапа, Vyana (vital airs), the qualities of Rajas (darkness), Sattva (goodness) and Tamas (ignorance). He is beyond Tamas (ignorance). He is Udana, and Samana (vital airs). He is medicine and the medical man.

## \|\| 15.97-100 \|\|

*kūṭasthaḥ svaccharūpaśca sarvadehavivarjitaḥ \|*  
*cakṣurindriyahīnaśca vāgindriyavivarjitaḥ(600) \|\| 97 \|\|*

*hastendriyavihīnaśca pādābhyāṃ ca vivarjitaḥ \|*  
*pāyūpasthavihīnaśca marutāpavivarjitaḥ \|\| 98 \|\|*

*prabodhena vihīnaśca buddhyā caiva vi varjitaḥ \|*  
*cetasā vigataścaiva prāṇena ca vivarjitaḥ \|\| 99 \|\|*

*apānena vihīnaśca vyānena ca vivarjitaḥ(610) \|*  
*udānena vihīnaśca samānena vivarjitaḥ \|\| 100 \|\|*

97-100. He is perpetually and universally the same. His form is transparent and he is devoid of any form. He is devoid of the organs of vision and speech, of hands, fat, the organs of generation and excretion. He is devoid of great asceticism. He is devoid of perception, intellect, consciousness and vital airs. Prana, Арапа, Vyana, Udana and Samana.

## \|\| 15.101-103 \|\|

*ākāśena vihīnaśca vāyunā parivarjitaḥ \|*  
*agninā ca vihīnaśca udakena vivarjitaḥ \|\| 101 \|\|*

*pṛthivyā ca vihīnaśca śabdena ca vivarjitaḥ \|*  
*sparśena ca vihīnaśca sarvarūpavivarjitaḥ(620) \|\| 102 \|\|*

*rāgeṇa vigataścaiva aghena parivarjitaḥ \|*  
*śokena rahitaścaiva vacasā parivarjitaḥ \|\| 103 \|\|*

101-103. He is devoid of the ether and fire, water and earth. He is devoid of sound, touch and all colours. He is devoid of carnal passion and other inferior appetites. He is shorn of grief and the power of speech.

## \|\| 15.104 \|\|

*rajo vivarjitaścaiva vikāraiḥ ṣaḍbhireva ca \|*  
*kāmena varjitaścaiva krodhena parivarjitaḥ \|\| 104 \|\|*

104\. He is devoid of the quality of Rajas darkness) and six-fold deviations from the natural state. He is devoid of sexual passion, anger, avarice, and pride.

## \|\| 15.105 \|\|

*lobhena vigataścaiva dambhena ca vivarjitaḥ \|*  
*sūkṣmaścaiva (630)susūkṣmaśca sthūlātsthūlatarastathā \|\| 105 \|\|*

105\. He is the subtlest of the subtle and the grossest of the gross.

## \|\| 15.106-107 \|\|

*viśārado balādhyakṣaḥ sarvasya kṣobhakastathā \|*  
*prakṛteḥ kṣobhakaścaiva mahataḥ kṣobhakastathā \|\| 106 \|\|*

*bhūtānāṃ kṣobhakaścaiva buddheśca kṣomakastathā \|*  
*indriyāṇāṃ kṣobhakaśca(640)viṣayakṣobhakastathā \|\| 107 \|\|*

106-107. He is clever, leader of the strong and the agitator of all. He agitates Prakrti (nature), Mahat (intellectual principle), the elements, intellect, the organs of sense and of the objects thereof.

## \|\| 15.108 \|\|

*brahmaṇaḥ kṣobhakaścaiva rudrasya kṣobhakastathā \|*  
*agamyaścakṣurādeśca śrotrāgamyastathaiva ca \|\| 108 \|\|*

108\. He is the agitator of Brahma and Rudra. He is beyond the range of the vision and hearing.

## \|\| 15.109 \|\|

*tvacā na gamyaḥ kūrṃmaśca jihvāgrāhyastathaiva ca \|*  
*grāṇondriyāgamya eva vācāgrāhyastathaiva ca (650) \|\| 109 \|\|*

109\. Skin cannot touch him. He is tortoise. Tongue cannot perceive him. He is beyond the range of smelling and speech.

## \|\| 15.110 \|\|

*agamyaścaiva pāṇibhyāṃ padāgamyastathaiva ca \|*  
*agrāhyo manasaścaiva buddhyāgrāhyo haristathā \|\| 110 \|\|*

110\. The hands and feet cannot reach him. Hari is beyond the range of mental and intellectual perception and understanding.

## \|\| 15.111-112 \|\|

*ahaṃ buddhyā tathā grāhyaścetasā grāhyā eva ca \|*  
*śaṅkhapāṇiścāvyayaśca gadāpāṇistathaiva ca (660) \|\| 111 \|\|*

*śārṅgapāṇiśca kṛṣṇaśca jñānamūrtiḥ parantapaḥ \|*  
*tapasvī jñānagamyo hi jñānī jñānavideva ca \|\| 112 \|\|*

111-112. Не is within the comprehension of the sense of ego and mental faculties. He holds the conch- shell in his hand, is undecaying and hold also the club and 6arnga bow in his hands. He is dark-blue, the image of knowledge and the scorcher of the enemies. He is within the range of the knowledge of the ascetics; he is endued with knowledge and knows all by his knowledge.

## \|\| 15.113 \|\|

*jñeyaśca jñeyahīnaśca (670) jñaptiścaitanyarūpakaḥ \|*  
*bhāvo bhāvyo bhavakaro bhāvano bhavanāśanaḥ \|\| 113 \|\|*

113\. He is comprehended by knowledge and manifests and consciousness of the objects of knowledge. He is the soul, object of mental perception, the creator of the world and the destroyer of it.

## \|\| 15.114 \|\|

*go vindo gopatirgopaḥ(680)sarvagopīsukhapradaḥ \|*  
*gopālo gogatiścaiva gomatirgodharastathā \|\| 114 \|\|*

114\. He is Govinda, the lord of kine and the giver of felicity unto the cow-herds. He is the protector of kine, the master of kine, Gomatl and Godhara.

## \|\| 15.115 \|\|

*upendraśca nṛsiṃhaśca śauriścaiva janārdanaḥ \|*  
*āraṇeyo(690) bṛhadbhānurbṛhaddīptistathaiva ca \|\| 115 \|\|*

115\. He is Upendra, Nrsimha, 6oun, Janarddana, Araneya, Vrhatbhanu and highly effulgent.

## \|\| 15.116 \|\|

*dāmodarastnikālaśca kālajñaḥ kālavarjitaḥ \|*  
*trisandhyo dvāparaṃ tretā prajādvāraṃ(700)trivikramaḥ \|\| 116 \|\|*

116\. He is Damodara, the three-fold time, cognizant of time and devoid of time. He is the three-fold Sandhya (periods of conjuction), is Dvapara, Treta, the creator of subjects and of the foot steps.

## \|\| 15.117 \|\|

*vikramo daṇḍa(ra) hastaśca hyekadaṇḍī tridaṇḍadhṛk \|*  
*sāmabhedastathopāyaḥ sāmarūpī ca sāmagaḥ \|\| 117 \|\|*

117\. Не is powerful and holds a rod in his hand. He holds one and three rods in his hand.

## \|\| 15.118 \|\|

*sāmavedoḥ(710)hyatharvaśca sukṛtaḥ sutarūpaṇaḥ \|*  
*atharvavedaviccaiva hyatharvācārya eva ca \|\| 118 \|\|*

118\. He is the division of the Samaveda, its means, of the form of Saman and the chanter of Saman. He is conversant with Atharvan Veda and is the preceptor thereof.

## \|\| 15.119 \|\|

*ṛgrūpī caiva ṛgveda ṛgvedeṣu pratiṣṭhitaḥ \|*  
*yajurvedo(720)yajurvedavidekapāt \|\| 119 \|\|*

119\. He is the Rk of the Rk Veda and is stationed there. He is the reader of the Yayus, the Yajurveda itself and is conversant with the rituals thereof.

## \|\| 15.120 \|\|

*bahupācca supāccaiva tathaiva ca sahasrapāt \|*  
*catuṣpācca dvipāccaiva smṛtirnyāyo yamo balī(730) \|\| 120 \|\|*

120\. He has one foot, many feet, beautiful foot, a thousand feet, four feet, two feet. The powerful lord is like unto Smrti and Nyaya.

## \|\| 15.121 \|\|

*sannyāsī cai sannayāsaścaturāśrama eva ca \|*  
*brahmacārī gṛhasthaśca vānaprasthaśca bhikṣukaḥ \|\| 121 \|\|*

121\. He is a Samnyasin (disassociated form the world, and is the four' orders of hermit etc. viz, a Brahmacarin (student), Grhastha (householder), Vanaprastha (retired into forest) and Bhiksu (a hermit living on alms).

## \|\| 15.122 \|\|

*brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vaiśyaḥ (740)śūdro varṇastathaiva ca \|*  
*śīladaḥ śīlasampanno duḥ śīlaparivarjitaḥ \|\| 122 \|\|*

122\. He is the four Varnas (castes) viz. the Brahmanas, the Ksatriyas, the Vaisyas and the Shudras. He gives good character, is endued with the same and devoid of a bad character.

## \|\| 15.123 \|\|

*mokṣo 'dhyātmasamāviṣṭaḥ stutiḥ stotā ca pūjakaḥ \|*  
*pūjyo(750)vāk karaṇaṃ caiva vācyaṃ caiva tu vācakaḥ \|\| 123 \|\|*

123\. Не is emancipation, is engaged in spiritual communion, is the encomiastic verse, the. encomiast and the worshipper. He is worship ful, «the speech, the object of speech and the speaker.

## \|\| 15.124 \|\|

*vettā vyākaraṇaṃ caiva vākyaṃ caiva ca vākyavit \|*  
*vākyagamyastīrthavāsī(760) tīrthastīrtho ca tīrthavit \|\| 124 \|\|*

124\. He is the knower, the grammar, the word and is conversant with words. He is within the reach of words, lives in sacred shrines, is the sacred shrine and is conversant with the knowledge of all the shrines.

## \|\| 15.125-126 \|\|

*tīrthādibhūtaḥ sāṃkhyaśca niruktaṃ tvadhidaivatam \|*  
*praṇavaḥ praṇaveśaśca praṇavena pravanditaḥ(770) \|\| 125 \|\|*

*praṇavena ca lakṣyo vai gāyatrī ca gadādharaḥ \|*  
*śālagrāmanivāsī ca (780)śālagrāmastathaiva ca \|\| 126 \|\|*

125-126. Не is resident in all the sacred shrines, is Sankhya, Nirukta and the presiding deity thereof. He is Pranava1 2, the lord of Pranava and is adored with Pranava. He is GayatfP and the holder of club. He lives in Salagrama and is Salagrama itself.

## \|\| 15.127 \|\|

*jalaśāyī yogaśāyī śeṣaśāyī kuśeśayaḥ \|*  
*mahībhartā ca (790) kāryaṃ ca kāraṇaṃ pṛthivīdharaḥ \|\| 127 \|\|*

127\. He resides in water, lies in Yoga, on 6esa and Kusa. He is the earth, is the action, the cause and the holder of the earth.

## \|\| 15.128 \|\|

*prajāpatiḥ śāśvataśca kāmyaḥ kāmayitā virāṭ \|*  
*samrāṭ pūṣā(800) tathā svargo rathasthaḥ sārathirbalam \|\| 128 \|\|*

128\. Не is the Patriarch, and the eternal. He is the object of desire and the universal creator of desire. He is the Lord Paramount, the sun, the heaven, is stationed on a car and the strength of the charioteer.

## \|\| 15.129 \|\|

*dhanī dhanaprado dhanyo yādavānāṃ hite rataḥ \|*  
*arjunasya priyaścaiva hyarjuno(810)bhīma eva ca \|\| 129 \|\|*

129\. He is rich, the giver of riches, blessed and engaged in the well-being of the Yadavas. He is the favourite of Arjuna and he is both Arjuna and Bhima.

## \|\| 15.130 \|\|

*parākramo durviṣahaḥ sarvaśāstraviśāradaḥ \|*  
*sārasvato mahābhīṣmaḥ pārijātaharastathā \|\| 130 \|\|*

130\. Unbearable is his prowess and he is a master of all the scriptures. He is Sarasvatl, he great Bhisma and the captor of Parijata flowers.

## \|\| 15.131 \|\|

*amṛtasya pradātā ca kṣīrodaḥ kṣīrameva ca (820) \|*  
*indrātmajastasya goptā govardhanadharastathā \|\| 131 \|\|*

131\. He is the giver of ambrosia, the ocean of milk and the milk itself. He is the protector of Indra's son and the upholder of the mount Govardhana.

## \|\| 15.132 \|\|

*kaṃsasya nāśanastadvaddhastipo hastināśanaḥ \|*  
*śipiviṣṭaḥ prasannaśca sarvalokārtināśanaḥ \|\| 132 \|\|*

132\. He is the destroyer of Kansa, the master of his elephant and the killer of the same. He is Shipivistal (pervaded by rays), cheerfulness and the destroyer of the calamities of the all people.

## \|\| 15.133 \|\|

*mudro(830)mudrā karaścaiva sarvamudrāvivarjitaḥ \|*  
*dehī dehasthitaścaiva dehasya ca niyāmakaḥ \|\| 133 \|\|*

133\. He is Mudra, the maker of Mudras and is devoid of all Mudras. He is endued with a body, is stationed in a body and the organizer of the body.

## \|\| 15.134 \|\|

*śrotrā śrotraniyantā ca śrotavyaḥ śravaṇaṃ tathā \|*  
*tvaksthitaśca(840)sparśayitvā spṛśyaṃ ca sparśanaṃ tathā \|\| 134 \|\|*

134\. He is the hearer, the creator of the ears, the object of hearing and the power of hearing. He is. stationed in skin, is one who touches, the object and power of touching.

## \|\| 15.135 \|\|

*rūpadraṣṭā ca cakṣuḥ stho niyantā cakṣuṣastathā \|*  
*dṛśyaṃ caivatu jihvāstho rasajñaśca niyāmakaḥ (850) \|\| 135 \|\|*

135\. Не resides in the eye, is the seer of forms and the creator of the eye and is the object of vision. He resides in the tongue, has a strong taste and is the organiser of taste.

## \|\| 15.136 \|\|

*ghrāṇastho ghrāṇakṛd ghrātā ghrāṇendriyaniyāmakaḥ \|*  
*vākstho vaktā ca vaktavyo vacanaṃ vāṅniyāmakaḥ \|\| 136 \|\|*

136\. He resides in smell, creates smell, himself smells and is the creator of the organ of smelling. He resides in speech, is the speaker, the object of speaking, the power of speech and the creator of the same.

## \|\| 15.137-138 \|\|

*prāṇisthaḥ (860)śilpa kṛcchilpo hastayośca niyāmakaḥ \|*  
*padavyaścaiva gantā ca gantavyaṃ gamanaṃ tathā \|\| 137 \|\|*

*niyantā pādayoścaiva pādyabhākca visargakṛt(870) \|*  
*visargasya niyantā ca hyupasthasthaḥ sukhaṃ tathā \|\| 138 \|\|*

137-138. He resides in vital airs. He is the creator of fine arts, is the fins art itself and the creator of hands. He is the foot, the agent of going, the place of going and the power of going. He is the ordainer of gifts, is stationed in the organ of generation and is the pleasure.

## \|\| 15.139-140 \|\|

*upasthasya niyantā ca tadānandakaraśca ha \|*  
*śatrughnaḥ kārtavīryaśca dattātreyastathaiva ca \|\| 139 \|\|*

*alarkasya hitaścaiva kārtavīryanikṛntanaḥ (880) \|*  
*kālanemirmahānemirmegho meghapatistathā \|\| 140 \|\|*

139-140. Не is the slayer of enemies, Kartavlrya, Dattatreya, is engaged in the well-being of Alarka and is the destroyer of Kartavlrya. He is Kalaneml. Mahanemi, the cloud and the lord of clouds.

## \|\| 15.141 \|\|

*annaprado 'nnarūpī ca hyannādo 'nnapravartakaḥ \|*  
*dhūmakṛddhūmarūpaśca(890) devakīputra uttamaḥ \|\| 141 \|\|*

141\. He is the giver of food, of the form of food, the eater of food and the ordainer of food. He creates smoke and is.of a smoky form.

## \|\| 15.142 \|\|

*devakyānandano nando rohiṇyāḥ priya eva ca \|*  
*vasudevapriyaścaiva vasudevasutastathā \|\| 142 \|\|*

142\. He is the most excellent son of Devakl. He is the delight of Devaki. Nanda and Rohinl. He is a favourite of Vasudeva and his son.

## \|\| 15.143 \|\|

*dundubhirhāsarūpaśca puṣpahāsastathaiva ca (900) \|*  
*aṭṭahāsapriyaścaiva sarvādhyakṣaḥ kṣaro 'kṣaraḥ \|\| 143 \|\|*

143\. His smiles are both like Dundubhl (trumpets) and flowers. He is fond of laughing aloud. He is the lord of all, decaying and undecaying.

## \|\| 15.144 \|\|

*acyutaścaiva satyeśaḥ satyāyāśca priyo varaḥ \|*  
*rukmiṇyāśca patiścaiva rukmiṇyā vallabhastathā \|\| 144 \|\|*

144\. He is Acyuta (undecaying), the lord of truth and is found of truth. He is the most beloved husband of Rukmini.

## \|\| 15.145-146 \|\|

*gopīnāṃ vallabhaścaiva(910)puṇyaślokaśca viśrutaḥ \|*  
*vṛṣākapiryamo guhyo makulaśca budhastathā \|\| 145 \|\|*

*rāhuḥ keturgraho grāho(920) gajendramukhamelakaḥ \|*  
*grāhasya vinihantā ca grāmī rakṣakastathā \|\| 146 \|\|*

145-146. He is the favourite of milk women and his piety has been sung in well known verses. He is Vrsakapi, Yama, Guhya, Mangala, Budha, Rahu, Ketu, the crocodile and the union of the mouths of the elephants. He is the destroyer of crocodile and the protector of the headmen of villages.

## \|\| 15.147 \|\|

*kinnaraścaiva siddhaśca chandaḥ svacchanda eva ca \|*  
*viśvarūpo viśālākṣo(930) daityasūdana eva ca \|\| 147 \|\|*

147\. He is the Kinnara, Siddha, the prosody and easiness. He is of the universal form, of large eyes and the slayer of the Daityas.

## \|\| 15.148 \|\|

*anantarūpo bhūtastho devadānavasaṃsthitaḥ \|*  
*suṣuptisthaḥ suṣuptiśca sthānaṃ sthānānta eva ca \|\| 148 \|\|*

148\. Не is of endless forms, is stationed in elements, in the celestials and Danavas. He exists in dreamless sleep, is dreamless sleep itself and is the place for it.

## \|\| 15.149 \|\|

*jagatsthaścaiva jāgartā sthānaṃ jāgaritaṃ tathā (940) \|*  
*svaprasthaḥ svapravitsvapnasthānaṃ svapnastathaiva ca \|\| 149 \|\|*

149\. He exists in an awakened state, is the agent and the place thereof. He exists in the state of dreamless sleep, is conversant with it and is the dream itself.

## \|\| 15.150 \|\|

*jāgratsvapnasuṣuptaiśca vihīno vai caturthakaḥ \|*  
*vijñānaṃ vedyarūpaṃ ca jīvo jīvayitā tathā (950) \|\| 150 \|\|*

150\. He also exists in the fourth state devoid of these three states of dreamless sleep, dreaming sleep and awakening. He is the discriminating knowledge, is Caitra, the sentiency and the creator of sentiencies.

## \|\| 15.151 \|\|

*bhuvanādhipatiścaiva bhuvanānāṃ niyāmakaḥ \|*  
*pātālavāsī pātālaṃ sarvajvaravināśanaḥ \|\| 151 \|\|*

151\. He is the lord of the worlds and the ordainer of the worlds. He resides in the nether region, the nether region itself and the destroyer of all sorts of feverish complaints.

## \|\| 15.152 \|\|

*paramānandarūpī ca dharṃmāṇāṃ ca pravartakaḥ \|*  
*sulabho durlabhaścaiva prāṇāyāmaparastathā(960) \|\| 152 \|\|*

152\. He is of the form of great felicity and the propounder of various forms of faith. He is easily accessible, and accessible with difficulty. He is engaged in Pranayama (suppression of vital air).

## \|\| 15.153 \|\|

*pratyāhāro dhārakaśca pratyāhārakarastathā \|*  
*prabhā kāntistathā hyarciḥ śuddhasphaṭikasannibhaḥ \|\| 153 \|\|*

153\. He is Pratyahara1, Dharaka2 and the maker of Pratyahara. He is effulgence, personal grace, rays, pure and like unto crystal.

## \|\| 15.154 \|\|

*agrāhaścaiva gauraśca sarvaḥ(970)śucirabhiṣṭutaḥ \|*  
*vaṣaṭkāro vaṣaḍ vauṣaṭ svadhā svāhā ratistathā \|\| 154 \|\|*

154\. Не is above perception, white coloured, the all and pure. He is Vasatkara3, Vasat, Vousat, Swadha, Swaha and inclination thereto.

## \|\| 15.155 \|\|

*paktā nandayitā(980)bhoktā boddhā bhāvayitā tathā \|*  
*jñānātmā caiva dehātmā bhū(u) mā sarveśvareśvaraḥ \|\| 155 \|\|*

155\. Не is the agent of cooking, giving delight, eating, understanding and thinking. He is identical with knowledge and understanding. He is the Great and the Creator of all Creators.

## \|\| 15.156 \|\|

*nadī nandī ca nandīśo(990)bhāratastarunāśanaḥ \|*  
*cakrapaḥ śrīpatiścaiva nṛpāṇāṃ cakravartinām \|\| 156 \|\|*

156\. He is the river, Nandi4, the lord of Nandi and the destroyer of the trees of India. He is the holder of discus, the husband of Shri and the king of the Lords Paramount.

## \|\| 15.157 \|\|

*īśaśca sarvadevānāṃ dvārakāsaṃsthitastathā \|*  
*puṣkaraḥ puṣkarādhyakṣaḥ puṣkaradvīpa eva ca (1000) \|\| 157 \|\|*

157\. He is the master of all the celestials and is the leisure. He is Puskara5, the lord of Puskara and the Puskara island.

## \|\| 15.158 \|\|

*bharato janako janyaḥ sarvākāravi varjitaḥ \|*  
*nirākāro nirnimitto nirātaṅko nirāśrayaḥ (1008) \|\| 158 \|\|*

158\. He is Bharata, Janaka, Janya6 and is devoid of all forms. He is without any form, without any cause, without any fear and without any help.

## \|\| 15.159 \|\|

*iti nāmasahasraṃ te vṛṣabhadhvaja kīrtitam \|*  
*devasya viṣṇorīśaśya sarvapāpavināśanam \|\| 159 \|\|*

159\. О bull-emblemed deity, I have thus described to you the thousand names of the Lord Visnu destructive of all sins.

## \|\| 15.160 \|\|

*paṭhandvijaśca viṣṇutvaṃ kṣatriyo jayamāpnuyāt \|*  
*vaiśyo dhanaṃ sukhaṃ śūdro viṣṇubhaktisamanvitaḥ \|\| 160 \|\|*

160\. By reading them a Brahmana attains to Visnu-hood, a Ksatriya acquires victory, a VaiSya acquires riches and a 6udra is endued with reverential faith in Visnu.

## Chapter 16

## \|\| 16.1 \|\|

*rudra uvāca \|*  
*punardhyānaṃ samācakṣva śaṅkhacakragadādhara \|*  
*viṣṇorīśasya devasya śuddhasya paramātmanaḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Rudra said: — О holder of conch-shell, discus and club, do thou again describe the Dhyana (meditation) of the Deity, the Lord Visrtu, the pure, impersonal self.

## \|\| 16.2 \|\|

*hariruvāca \|*  
*śṛṇu rudra ! harerdhyānaṃ saṃsāratarunāśanam \|*  
*dṛśirūpamanantaṃ ca sarvavyāpyajamavyayam \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Hari said: — Hear, О Rudra, Hari's dhyana, destructive of the tree of transmigatory series, never seen before, extending all over and eternal.

## \|\| 16.3-4 \|\|

*akṣaraṃ sarvagaṃ nityaṃ mahabdrahmāsti kevalam \|*  
*sarvasya jagato mūlaṃ sarvagaṃ parameśavaram \|\| 3 \|\|*

*sarvabhūtahṛdisthaṃ vai sarvabhūtamaheśvaram \|*  
*sarvādhāraṃ nirādhāraṃ sarvakāraṇakāraṇam \|\| 4 \|\|*

3-4. It is undecaying present always, and every where and consists only in the thought "I am Brahma." \[Meditate on him as\] the root of the entire world, the lord of all, the Great Demiurgus, as stationed in the hearts of all creatures, as the great lord of all creatures. He is the container of all, having none to contain him and is the cause of all causes.

## \|\| 16.5-10 \|\|

*alepakaṃ tathā muktaṃ muktayogivicititam \|*  
*sthūladehavihīnaṃ ca cakṣuṣā parivarjitam \|\| 5 \|\|*

*vāgindriyavihīnaṃ ca prāṇidharṃmavivarjitam \|*  
*pādendriyavihīnaṃ ca vāgdharmaparivarjitam \|*  
*pāyūpasthavihīnaṃ ca sarvaiṃndriya vivarjitam \|\| 6 \|\|*

*manovirahitaṃ tadvanmanodharṃmavivarjitam \|*  
*buddhyā vihīnaṃ deveśaṃ cetasā parivarjitam \|\| 7 \|\|*

*ahaṅkāravihīnaṃ vai buddhidharṃmavivarjitam \|*  
*prāṇena rahitaṃ caiva hyapānena vivarjitam \|\| 8 \|\|*

*vyānākhyavāyuhīnaṃ vai prāṇadharṃmavivarjitam \|*  
*hariruvāca \|*  
*punaḥ sūryarcanaṃ vakṣye yaduktaṃ bhṛgave purā \|\| 9 \|\|*

*oṃ khakholkāya namaḥ \|*  
*sūryasya mūlamantro 'yaṃ bhuktimuktipradāyakaḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

5-10. He does not come in contact, is emancipated and is being meditated on by emancipated Yogins. He is without the gross body, the eyes, organs of vitality the action of vital airs, the organs of generation and execretion, the organs of sense, the mind, the action of mind, intellect, mental faculties, egoism, the action of intellect, the vital airs. Prana, Apana and their sactions. Hari said: — I will describe again the adoration of the sun which had been related formerly unto Bhrgu. Om salutation unto Khakholka. This is the principal man tram of the sun affording emancipation and objects of enjoyment.

## \|\| 16.11 \|\|

*oṃ khakholkāya tridaśāya namaḥ \|*  
*oṃ vici ṭhaṭha śirase namaḥ \|*  
*oṃ jñānine ṭhaṭha śikhāyai namaḥ \|*  
*oṃ sahasraraśmaye ṭhaṭha kavacāya namaḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Оm salutation unto God Khakholka. От unto rays, tha, tha, salutation unto the head. Om unto knowledge, salutation unto the tuft of hair on the head. Om unto him of thousand, tha, tha, salutation unto the amulet.

## \|\| 16.12 \|\|

*oṃ sarvatejo 'dhipataye ṭhaṭha astrāya namaḥ \|*  
*oṃ jvalajvala prajvalaprajvala ṭhaṭha namaḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Om salutation unto the master of all light. Tha, tha, salutation unto the weapon. Om, bum, bum, bunt, burn, tha, tha, satutuion.

## \|\| 16.13 \|\|

*agniprākāramantro 'yaṃ sūryasyāghavināśanaḥ \|*  
*oṃ ādityāya vidmahe.viśvabhā vāya dhīmahi. tannaḥ sūrya pracodayāt \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. This is the fiery mantram of the sum destructive of the sin. Om Adityaya, Vidmahe, Visvabhavaya Dhlmahl, Tarma Suryya Pracodayat.

## \|\| 16.14-16 \|\|

*sakalīkaraṇaṃ kuryādrāyatryā bhāskarasya ca \|*  
*dharṃmātmane ca pūrvasminyamā yeti ca dakṣiṇe \|\| 14 \|\|*

*daṇḍanāyakāya tato daivatāyeti cottare \|*  
*śyāmapiṅgalamaiśānyāmāgneyyāṃ dīkṣitaṃ yajet \|\| 15 \|\|*

*vajrapāṇiṃ ca nairṛtyāṃ bhūrbhuvaḥsvaśca vāyave \|*  
*oṃ candrāya nakṣatrādhipataye namaḥ \|*  
*oṃ aṅgārakāya kṣitisutāya namaḥ \|*  
*oṃ budhāya somasutāya namaḥ \|*  
*oṃ vāgīśvarāya sarvavidyādhipataye namaḥ \|*  
*oṃ śukrāya maharṣaye bhṛgusutāya namaḥ \|*  
*oṃ śanaiścarāya sūryātmajāya namaḥ \|*  
*oṃ rāhave namaḥ \|*  
*oṃ ketave namaḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

14-16. The worshipper should perform the Sakalikarana rite with this Gayatri of the sun. He should worship Dharma in the east, Yama is the south, Dandanayaka and Vaivarna in the north, dark-blue, twany and other colours in north-east and north-west, the holder of thunder-bolt in the south-west and the earth and sky in the north-west. Om salutation unto the moon the lord of stars. Om salutation unto egoism the son of the earth. Om, salutation unto Budha, the son of Soma. Om salutation unto the lord of speech, the master of all forms of learning. Om salutation unto Bhrgu's son, the great saint 6ukra. Om salutatation unto 6ani (Saturn) the son of the sun. Om salutation unto Rahu. Om salutation unto Ketu.

## \|\| 16.17 \|\|

*pūrvādīśānaparyantā ete pūjyā vṛṣadhvaja \|*  
*oṃ anūkāya namaḥ \|*  
*oṃ prathamanāthāya namaḥ \|*  
*oṃ buddhāya namaḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. In all the quarters beginning with the east and ending with the north-east all these should be adored, О bull-emblemed deity. Om satlutation unto Anuruka. Om salutation unto the lord of Pramathas.1 Om salutation unto Budha.

## \|\| 16.18 \|\|

*oṃ bhagavannaparimitamayūkhamālin ! sakalajagatpate ! saptāśvavāhana ! caturbhuja ! paramasiddhiprada ! visphuliṅgapiṅgala ! tata ehyehi idamarghyaṃ mama śirasi gataṃ gṛhṇagṛhṇa tejograrūpam anagna ! jvalajvala ṭhaṭha namaḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. О lord! О thou endued with immeasurable rays! О lord ofthe entire world! О thou carried by seven horses! О thou having four arms! О thou, the giver of great supernatural powers! О thou twanyco loured with scintillation! О auspicious deity, take this arghya. Salutation unto thee. Take this dreadful fire. Burn, bum, tha, tha, salutation.

## \|\| 16.19 \|\|

*anenāvāhya mantreṇa tataḥ sūryaṃ visarjayet \|*  
*oṃ namo bhagavate ādityāya sahasra kiraṇāya gaccha sukhaṃ punarāgamanāyeti \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Having invoked the sun-god with this mantram he should make the Visarjana (life- destroying rite) with the following mantram. Om salutation unto the sun endued with six lordly powers, of a thousasld rays. Go happily to return again.

## Chapter 17

## \|\| 17.1 \|\|

*hariruvāca \|*  
*punaḥ sūryārcanaṃ vakṣye yaduktaṃ dhanadāya hi \|*  
*aṣṭapatraṃ likhetpadmaṃ śucau deśe sakarṇikam \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Hari said: — I will describe the adoration of the sun formerly related unto the god of riches.2 In a purified place a worshipper should draw the figure of a lotus with eight petals and pericarps.

## \|\| 17.2 \|\|

*āvāhanīṃ tato baddhā mudrāmāvāhayedravim \|*  
*khakholkaṃ sthāpya mudrāṃ tu sthāpayenmantrarūpiṇīm \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Then making Avahan mudra3 he should invoke Hari there. He should place in the middle the diagram form of the sun and sprinkle it with water.

## \|\| 17.3 \|\|

*āgneyyāṃ diśi devasya hṛdayaṃ sthāpayecchiva ! \|*  
*aiśānyāṃ tu śiraḥ sthāpyaṃ nairṛtyāṃ vinyasecchikhām \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. He should place the heart of the deity in the quarter presided over by the fire-god. He should place the head in the north-east and the tuft of hair in the south-west.

## \|\| 17.4 \|\|

*paurandaryāṃ nyaseddharṃmamekāgrasthitamānasaḥ \|*  
*vāyavyāṃ caiva netraṃ tu vāruṇyāmastrameva ca \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. He, having his mind fixed in concentration, should assign Dharma to this quarter presided over by Purandara. He should place his eyes in the north-west and his weapon in the corner presided over by Varuna.

## \|\| 17.5 \|\|

*aiśānyāṃ sthāpayetsomaṃ paurandaryāṃ tu lohitam \|*  
*āgneyyāṃ somatanayaṃ yāmyāṃ caiva bṛhaspatim \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. He should place Soma in the north-east and Lohita in the quarter belonging to Purandara. He should place Soma is son in the east and Brhaspati in the south.

## \|\| 17.6 \|\|

*nairṛtyāṃ dānavaguruṃ vāruṇyāṃ tu śanaiścaram \|*  
*vāyavyāṃ ca tathā ketuṃ kauberyāṃ rāhumeva ca \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. He should place the preceptor of the Danavas in the south-west and Sani (Saturn) in the corner presided over by Varuna. He should place Ketu in the north-west and Rahu in the quarter presided over by Kubera.

## \|\| 17.7-8 \|\|

*dvitīyāyāṃ tu kakṣāyāṃ sūryāndvādaśa pūjayet \|*  
*bhagaḥ sūryor'yyamā caiva mitro vai varuṇastathā \|\| 7 \|\|*

*savitā caiva dhātā ca vivasvāṃśca mahābalaḥ \|*  
*tvaṣṭā pūṣā tathā cendro dvādaśo viṣṇurucyate \|\| 8 \|\|*

7-8. In the second apartment, he should ador.e the twelve suns viz. Bhaga, Surya, Aryam, Mitra, Varuna, Savita, Dhata, the highly powerful Vivaswan, Tvasta, Pusa, and Indra. The twelfth is Visnu.

## \|\| 17.9 \|\|

*pūrvādāvarcayeddevānindrādīñchraddhayā naraḥ \|*  
*jayā ca vijayā caiva jayanti cāparājitā \|*  
*śeṣaśca vāsukiścaiva nāgānityādi pūjayet \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. In the quarters beginning with the east, a man, filied with reverence, should adore Indra and other deities, Jaya, Vijaya, Jayanti Apara- jita, Shesa, Vasuki and other Nagas.

## Chapter 18

## \|\| 18.1 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*garuḍoktaṃ kaśyapāya vakṣye mṛtyuñjayārcanam \|*  
*uddhārapūrvakaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvadevamayaṃ matam \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Suta said: — I will describe the Arohana (adoration) of Mrtyunjaya (the victor of death) narrated unto Kagyapa by Garuda, which gaves redemption, is holy and identical with all the deities.

## \|\| 18.2 \|\|

*oṅkāraṃ pūrvamuddhṛtya ju(hu)ṅkāṃraṃ tadanantaram \|*  
*savisargaṃ tṛtīyaṃ syānmṛtyudāridrayamardanam \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. First Om should be placed, then junkara and thirdly Visarga. This mantram destroys death and poverty.

## \|\| 18.3 \|\|

*īśaviṣṇavarkadevyādikavacaṃ sarvasādhakam \|*  
*amṛteśaṃ mahāmantrantryakṣaraṃ pūjanaṃ samam \|*  
*japanānmṛtyuhīnāḥ syuḥ sarvapāpavivarjitāḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. This great mantram of three letters is the lord of ambrosia. By reciting it people become freed from death and all sorts of sins.

## \|\| 18.4 \|\|

*śatajapyādvedaphalaṃ yajñatīrthaphalaṃ labhet \|*  
*aṣṭottaraśatājjāpyātrisandhyaṃ mṛtyu śatrujita \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. By reciting it a hundred times one reaps the fruit of Vedic recitations and of the celebration of sacrifices at sacred places. By reciting it one hundred and eight times at three periods of junction of defeats the Death and his enemies.

## \|\| 18.5 \|\|

*dhyāyecca sitapadmasthaṃ varadaṃ cābhayaṃ kare \|*  
*dvābhyāṃ cāmṛtakumbhaṃ tu cintayedamṛteśvaram \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. He should meditate on the lord of ambrosia, seated on a white lotus, the giver of boons, with the promise of protection in one hand and jars full of nectar in two other hands.

## \|\| 18.6 \|\|

*tasyaivāṅgagatāṃ devīmamṛtāmṛtabhāṣiṇī(vini) m \|*  
*kalaśaṃ dakṣiṇe haste vāmahaste saroruham \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. He should think of the goddess of ambrosia as stationed on his limb, sweet-speeched like ambrosia, holding the pitcher in her right hand and lotus in the left.

## \|\| 18.7 \|\|

*japedaṣṭasahasraṃ vai trisandhyaṃ māsamekataḥ \|*  
*jarāmṛtyumahāvyādhiśatrucchivaśāntidam \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. He, who recites it eight thousand time at the three periods of junction for one full month, becomes freed from decrepitude, death and leprosy, defeats his enemies and gives peace unto all creatures.

## \|\| 18.8-9 \|\|

*āhvānaṃ sthāpanaṃ rodhaṃ sannidhānaṃ niveśanam \|*  
*pādyamā camanaṃ snānamarghyaṃ sraganulepanam \|\| 8 \|\|*

*dīpāṃbaraṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ ca naivadyaṃ pānavījanam \|*  
*mātrāmudrājapadhyānaṃ dakṣiṇā cāhutiḥ stutiḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

8-9. He is the (real) worshipper who knows the site (of a temple), the placing (of an idol), the suppression of vital airs, the appearance, the temple, water for washing feet, the water for rinsing mouth, the water for bathing, Arghya, Aguru, pastes, lamps, raiments, ornaments, edibles, drinks, drinking water, Matra, Mudra,.recitation, meditation, gifts, oblation.

## \|\| 18.10-11 \|\|

*vādyaṃ gatiṃ ca nṛtyaṃ ca nyāsayogaṃ pradakṣiṇam \|*  
*praṇatirmantraśayyā ca vandanaṃ ca visarjanam \|\| 10 \|\|*

*ṣaḍaṅgādiprakāreṇa pūjanaṃ tu kramoditam \|*  
*parameśamukhodrītaṃ yo jānāti sa pūjakaḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

10-11. The chanting of glories, playing of musical instruments, singing, dancing, Nyasa (assign- ment of limbs), yoga, circumambulation, bowing, matrams, clarified butter, eulogy, (the life-destroying rite) Visarjana, the adoration woth six ingredients emanating inorder from the mouth of the great Deity.

## \|\| 18.12 \|\|

*arghyapātrārcanaṃ cādāvastreṇaiva tu tāḍanam \|*  
*śodhanaṃ kavacenaiva amṛtīkaraṇaṃ tataḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. The Arghya, Padya, etc., should be fanned with a piece of cloth, and then purified with Kavaca mantrams and then the rite of Amrti- karana (conversion into nectar) should be performed.

## \|\| 18.13-14 \|\|

*pūjā cādhāraśaktyādeḥ prāṇāyāmaṃ tathāsane \|*  
*pīṭhasuddhiṃ tataḥ kuryācchoṣaṇādyaistataḥ smaret \|\| 13 \|\|*

*ātmānaṃ devarūpaṃ ca karāṅganyāsakaṃ caret \|*  
*ātmānaṃ pūjayetpaścājyo tīrūpaṃ hṛdabjataḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

13-14. The Adhara Saktis' should be adored and Pranayama (suppression of vital airs) should be practised ill the seat. Then the purificatory rite of PindaII 1 2 should be performed. Then with Agni and other mantrams he should meditate on the self as being identical with the deity. He should then make assignment of hands and other limbs and afterwards adore the self in the form of light stationed in the lotus of the heart.

## \|\| 18.15 \|\|

*mūrtau vā sthaṇḍile vāpi kṣipetpuṣpaṃ tu bhāsvaram \|*  
*āhvānadvārapūjārthaṃ pūjā cādhāraśaktitaḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Не should then throw shining flowers on the idol or the altar. For the adoration of the door of the self the Adhara Saktis should be worshipped.

## \|\| 18.16 \|\|

*sānnidhyakaraṇaṃ deve parivārasya pūjanam \|*  
*aṅgaṣaṭkasya pūjā vai kartavyā ca vipaścitaiḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. And bringing one's self near the deity he worships h is family. For the adoration of six Angas (limbs) the quarters should be divided.

## \|\| 18.17 \|\|

*dharmādayaśca śakrādyāḥ sāyudhāḥ parivārakāḥ \|*  
*yugavedamuhūrtāśca pūjeyaṃ bhuktimuktikṛt \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Dharma and other gods, Йакга and other celestials, the various members of their families and their weapons, the cycles, and the Muhurttas (divisions of time) should be adored. This worship yields enjoyment and emanci pation.

## \|\| 18.18 \|\|

*mātṛkāśca gaṇāṃścādau nandigaṅge ca pūjayet \|*  
*mahākālaṃ ca yamanāṃ dehalyāṃ pūjayetpurā \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. He should first adore the Matrkas, Ganas, Nandigana, Mahakala, Yamuna and Dehalya.

## \|\| 18.19 \|\|

*oṃ amṛteśvara oṃ bhairavāya namaḥ \|*  
*evaṃ oṃ juṃ haṃsaḥ sūryāya namaḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. От salutation unto Bhairava, the lord of ambrosia. Evem, От, Jum, Hamsah, salutation unto the sun.

## \|\| 18.20 \|\|

*evaṃ śivāya kṛṣṇāya brahmaṇe ca gaṇāya ca \|*  
*caṇḍikāyai sarasvatyai mahālakṣmādi pūjayet \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. In This way adorations should be offered to 6lva, Krsna, Brahma, Gana Candlika, Sarasvatl, MahalaksmI and others.

## Chapter 19

## \|\| 19.1-2 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*prāṇeśvaraṃ gāruḍaṃ ca śivoktaṃ pravadāmyaham \|*  
*sthānānyādau pravakṣyāmi nāgadaṣṭo na jīvati \|\| 1 \|\|*

*citāvalmīkaśailādau kape ca vivare taroḥ \|*  
*daṃśe rekhātrayaṃ yasya pracchannaṃ sa na jīvati \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Suta said: — I will now describe the Pranesvara1 rite of Garuda narrated by Shiva. I shall first describe the places where aperson, bitten by a serpent, does not survive, viz., funeral pyre, ant-hill, well, and the cavity of a tree. The person, three lines on whose limbs, are hidden, does not live.

## \|\| 19.3-4 \|\|

*ṣaṣṭhyāṃ ca karkaṭe meṣe mūlāśleṣāmaghādiṣu \|*  
*kakṣāśroṇigale sandhau śaṅkhakarṇodarādiṣu \|\| 3 \|\|*

*daṇḍī śastradharo bhikṣurna gnādiḥ kāladūtakaḥ \|*  
*bāhau ca vakkre grīvāyāṃ daṣṭāyāṃ na hi jīvati \|\| 4 \|\|*

3-4. \[A man dies if he is bitten\] in the sixth day of the fort-night, when the sun is in the constellation Cancer, when it is in the Aries, when it is with the asterism Mula or when it is in the Magha1 2 or Aslesa3. \[A man dies when he is bitten\] on the sides, on the loins, on the throat, on the joints or the temple, ears or belly. The Dandin (hermit), a person holding weapons, a mendicant and a naked person are the emissaries of Death4. If a person is bitten on the mouth, anus, neck, and on the back, he does not survive.

## \|\| 19.5 \|\|

*pūrvaṃ dinapatirbhuṅkte ardhayāmaṃ tato 'pare \|*  
*śeṣā grahāḥ pratidinaṃ ṣaṭsaṃkhyā parivartanaiḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Every day the sun, first of all, lords, for half a Yama,5 over all the serpents. Then with six revolutions the six planets lord over them. In the night with five revolutions the five planets lord over them.

## \|\| 19.6-7 \|\|

*nāgabhogaḥ kramāñjñeyo rātrau bāṇavivartanaiḥ \|*  
*śeṣor'kaḥ phaṇipaścandrastakṣako bhauma īritaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

*karkoṭo jño guruḥ padmo mahāpadmaśca bhārgavaḥ \|*  
*śaṅkhaḥ śanaiścaro rāhuḥ kulikaścāhayo grahāḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

6-7. The sun is the presiding star of Sesa, the moon of Phan!, Mars of Taksaka, Jupiter of Karkotajna, Venus of Padma and Mahapadma, Saturn of &ankha, and Rahu of Kuluka and Ahl.

## \|\| 19.8-9 \|\|

*rātrau divā suragurorbhāge syādamarāntakaḥ \|*  
*paṅgoḥ kāle divā rāhuḥ kulikena saha sthitaḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

*yāmārdhasandhisaṃsthāṃ ca velāṃ kālavatīṃ caret \|*  
*bāṇadviṣaḍvahnivājiyugabhūrekabhāgataḥ? \|\| 9 \|\|*

8-9. Jupiter is the Death itself in both days and nights6. Sarurn is Death in the day and the period when Rahu presides over Kuluka at the hours of the conjunction of two-half Yamas, it is hostile to life.

## \|\| 19.10 \|\|

*divā ṣaḍedanetrādripañcatrimānuṣāṃśakaiḥ \|*  
*pādāṅguṣṭhe pādapṛṣṭhe pādapṛṣṭhe gulphe jānuni liṅgake \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. A day, consisting of sixty dandas7, should be distributed over a human body divided into three sections. Five dandas should be assigned to the toe, twelve to the feet, five to the calf, two to the knee and one to the organ of generation.

## \|\| 19.11 \|\|

*nābhau hṛdi stanataṭe kaṇṭhe nāsāpuṭe 'kṣiṇi \|*  
*karṇayośca bhruvoḥ śaṅkhe mastake pratipatkramāt \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Six dandas should be assigned to the navel, four to the breast and eight to the throat. Fifteen danda should be allotted to the tip of the nose and one each to the eye, ear, eye-brow, and temple. Then all the days, beginning with Pratipat, the first day of a fort night, should be allotted to all the limbs beghming with the head.

## \|\| 19.12-13 \|\|

*tiṣṭhaccandraśca jīvecca puṃso dakṣiṇabhāgake \|*  
*kāyasya vāmabhāge tu striyā vāyuvahātkarāt \|\| 12 \|\|*

*amṛtastatkṛto moho nivarteta ca mardanāt \|*  
*ātmanaḥ paramaṃ bījaṃ haṃsākhyaṃ sphaṭikāmalam \|\| 13 \|\|*

12-13. If the moon lords over the right part of a man's body he does not survive. If it lords over the left part of a woman's body she dies. The benumbed part should be rubbed over with a hand till unconsciousness is not removed.

## \|\| 19.14 \|\|

*dātavyaṃ viṣapāpaghnaṃ bījaṃ tasya caturvidham \|*  
*vindupañcasvarayutamādyamuktaṃ dvitīyakam \|*  
*ṣaṣṭhārūḍhaṃ tṛtīyaṃ syātsavisargaṃ caturthakam \|*  
*oṃ kuru kule svāhā \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. The great mantram of self, pure like crystal, called Hamsa, is to be known as one which counteracts the evil effect of poisoning. Its BJja is of four sorts. Om, Kuru, Kunde Swaha.

## \|\| 19.15 \|\|

*vidyā trailokyarakṣārthaṃ garuḍena dhṛtā purā \|*  
*vadhepsurnāganāgānāṃ mukhe 'tha praṇavaṃ nyaset \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Formerly this learning was kept by Garuda for protecting the tree worlds. Desirous of killing the serpents he assigned Pranava to his mouth.

## \|\| 19.16 \|\|

*gale kuru nyaseddhīmānkule ca gulphayoḥ smṛtaḥ \|*  
*svāhā pādayuge caiva yugahā nyāsa īritaḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. An intelligent worshipper should assign Kuru to his throat, Kunda to the claves, and Suahd to the tow feet. This Nydsa is called Yugaha.

## \|\| 19.17 \|\|

*gṛhe vivikhitā yatra tannāgāḥ saṃtyajanti ca \|*  
*sahasramantraṃ japtvā tu karṇe sūtraṃ dhṛtaṃ tathā \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. The serpents leave the house in which this mantram is written. Having recited it a thousand time one should place a thread on his ear.

## \|\| 19.18 \|\|

*yadrṛhe śarkarā japtā kṣiptā nāgāstyajanti tat \|*  
*saptalakṣasya japyāddhi siddhiḥ prāptā surāsuraiḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. The serpents leave the house in which suger, after reciting this mantram, is thrown. By reciting it seven lacs of times the celestials and Asuras obtain Siddhi.

## \|\| 19.19 \|\|

*oṃ suvarṇarekhe kukkuṭavigraharūpiṇi svāhā \|*  
*evañcāṣṭadale padma dale varṇayugaṃ likhet \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Om, Swaha unto golden lines, into him having the form of a fowl. In this way two letters whould written on each petal of a lotus of eighteen petals.

## \|\| 19.20 \|\|

*nāmaitadvāridhārābhiḥ snāto daṣṭo viṣaṃ tyajet \|*  
*oṃ pakṣi svāhā \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. When a person, bitten by a snake, is sprinkled with water with this mantram the poison goes out. Om, paksi (bird) Swaha.

## \|\| 19.21 \|\|

*aṅguṣṭhādi kaniṣṭhāntaṃ kare nyasyātha dehake \|*  
*ke (kai) vakkre hṛdi liṅge ca pādayorgaruḍasya hi \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. Then the assignment of all fingers., beginning with the thumb and ending with the youngest finger, should be made in the body. Garuda should be assigned to the mind, mouth heart, organ of generation and feet.

## \|\| 19.22 \|\|

*nākrāmanti ca tacchāyāṃ svapne 'pi viṣapannagāḥ \|*  
*yastu lakṣaṃ japeccāsyāḥ sa dṛṣṭvā(ṣṭyā) nāśayedviṣam \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. Even in a dream the venomous serpents do not transgress his shadow. He, who recites this mantram tor a lac of times, destroys the poison even by his very sight.

## \|\| 19.23-24 \|\|

*oṃ hrī hrau hrīṃ bhi(bhī) ruṇḍāyai svāhā \|*  
*karṇe japtā tviyaṃ vidyā daṣṭakasya viṣaṃ haret \|\| 23 \|\|*

*a ā nyasettu pādāgre i ī gulaphe 'tha jānuni \|*  
*u ū e ai kaṭitaṭe o nābhau hṛdi au nyaset \|\| 24 \|\|*

23-24. Om, Hrom, Hroum, Bhirundayai Swaha. Having recited this mantram by placing his finger on the ear one should destroy the poison of the person bitten. He should then assign a, ato the tips of the feet, i.i to the calves and knees, u, u, e, ai to the waist, oh to the navel, and aur to the heart.

## \|\| 19.25 \|\|

*vakkre amuttamāṅge aḥ nyasedvai haṃsasaṃyutāḥ \|*  
*haṃso viṣādi ca harejjapto dhyāto 'tha pūjitaḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. He should assign am to the mouth and ah to the hart. Hamsa, when recited, meditated on and adored, destroy all sorts of poison.

## \|\| 19.26 \|\|

*garuḍo 'hamiti dhyātvā kuryādviṣaharāṃ (rīṃ) kriyām \|*  
*haṃmantraṃ gātravinyastaṃ viṣādiharamīritam \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. Having meditated 'I am Garuda' he should perform the rite destructive of poison. Having assigned the mantram Ham to the body he should say "Destroy poison, etc."

## \|\| 19.27 \|\|

*nyasya haṃsaṃ vāmakare nāsāmukhanirodhakṛt \|*  
*mantro hareddaṣṭakasya tvaṅmāṃsādigataṃ viṣam \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. Having assigned Haritsa to the left hand, he should close up his mouth and nostrils. This mantram destroys the poison affecting the skin and flesh.

## \|\| 19.28 \|\|

*sa vāyunā samākṛṣya daṣṭānāṃ garalaṃ haret \|*  
*tanau nyaseddaṣṭakasya nīlakaṇṭhādi saṃsmaret \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. Having attracted it by the air he should remove the poison of the person bitten. He should next assign it to the body of the person bitten and meditate on the blue-throated deity (Shiva).

## \|\| 19.29 \|\|

*pītaṃ pratyaṅgirāmūlaṃ taṇḍuladbhirviṣāpaham \|*  
*punarnavāphalinīnāṃ mūlaṃ vakkrajamīdṛśam \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. When the juice of the root of Pratyahgira is drunk with rice it destroys poison. The root of the new Phalin is equally effective.

## \|\| 19.30 \|\|

*mūlaṃ śuklabṛhatyāstu karkoṭyāgairikarṇikam \|*  
*adbhirghṛṣṭaghṛtopetalepo 'yaṃ viṣamardanaḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. When clarified butter is pasted on the head it also destroys poison.

## \|\| 19.31 \|\|

*viṣamṛddhiṃ na vrajecca uṣṇaṃ pibati yo ghṛtam \|*  
*pañcāṅgaṃ tu śirīṣasya mūlaṃ gṛñjanajaṃ tathā \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. If a person drinks up hot ghee (clarified butter) the poison is not increased. If the root of &irisa compounded in five parts with one part of red garlic (Grinjana) is pasted all over the body or is drunk it destroys posion.

## \|\| 19.32-33 \|\|

*sarvāṅgalepataśacāpi pānādvā viṣahṛdbhavet \|*  
*hrīṃ gonasādiviṣahṛt \|\| 32 \|\|*

*hṛllalāṭavisargāntaṃ dhyātaṃ vaśyā dikṛdbhavet \|*  
*nyastaṃ yonau vaśetkanyāṃ kuryānmadajalāvilam \|\| 33 \|\|*

32-33. Hrim destroys the posion of Gonasa (a large kind of snake Boa). When the mantram Hrim ending with Visarga is meditated on it brings all under control; when it is assigned to the female organ it brings a maiden under control and clears up the muddy water.

## \|\| 19.34 \|\|

*japtvā saptāṣṭasāhasraṃ garutmāniva sarvagaḥ \|*  
*kaviḥ syācchrutidharī ca vaśyāḥ strīścāyurāpnuyāt \|*  
*viṣahṛtsyātkathā tadvanmaṇirvyāsaḥ smṛto dhruvam \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. Having recited "Garuda is every where" fifty-six thousand times a person becomes a poet, well read in 6ruti and obtains a submissive wife. The theme of the Muni Vyasa forsooth destroys poison.

## Chapter 20

## \|\| 20.1 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*vakṣye tatparamaṃ guhyaṃ śivoktaṃ mantrabṛndakam \|*  
*pāśaṃ dhanuśca cakraṃ ca mudraraṃ śūlapaṭṭiśam \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Suta said: -I will now describe the highly secret mantrams narrated by Shiva. His weapons are the noose, the bow, the discus, the club, the dart and Pattisa.

## \|\| 20.2-4 \|\|

*etairevāyudhairyuddhe mantraiḥ śatrūñjayennṛpaḥ \|*  
*mantroddhāraḥ padmapātre ādi pūrvādike likhet \|\| 2 \|\|*

*aṣṭavargaṃ cāṣṭamaṃ ca khyātamīśānapatrake \|*  
*oṃ kāro brahma bījaṃ syāddhrīṅkāro viṣṇureva ca \|\| 3 \|\|*

*hrīṅkā raśca śivaḥ śūle triśākhe tu kramānnyaset \|*  
*oṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ \|\| 4 \|\|*

2-4. Having used these weapons inspired with mantrams in a battle a king conquers his enemies. The mantram for purifying the mantrams should be first written on a lotus petal. Om is the Brahma BijamK H rim is the Visnu Btjam. These three bijams should be assigned to the head of Siva thrice in order. Om. Hrim, Hrim.

## \|\| 20.5 \|\|

*śūlaṃ gṛhītvā hastenābhrāmya cākāśasaṃmukham \|*  
*taddarśanāndrahā nāgā dṛṣṭvā vā nāśamāpnu yuḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Having taken up the dart in his hand he should whirl it in the sky. By seeing it all the evil stars and serpents are destroyed.

## \|\| 20.6 \|\|

*dhūmārakte karaṃ madhye dhyātvā khe cintayennaraḥ \|*  
*duṣṭā nāgā grahā meghā vinaśyanti ca rākṣasāḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Having held the smoky coloured bow by the hand a man should meditate on it in the sky. By it the wicked serpents, the evil stars, clouds and Raks asas are destroyed.

## \|\| 20.7 \|\|

*trilokānrakṣayenmantro martyalokasya kā kathā \|*  
*oṃ jūṃ sūṃ hūṃ phaṭ \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. This mantram protects the three worlds, that to speak of the land of mortals? Om, Jum, Sam, Hum, Phat.

## \|\| 20.8 \|\|

*khādirānkīlakānaṣṭau kṣetre saṃmantrya vinyaset \|*  
*na tatra vajrapātasya sphūrjathvāderupadravaḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. Eight sticks of catechu wood, inspired widl mantrams, should be placed on the ground. That will prevent the falling of thunder-bolt.

## \|\| 20.9 \|\|

*garuḍoktairmahāmantraiḥ kīlakānaṣṭa mantrayet \|*  
*ekaviṃśativārāṇi kṣetre tu nikhanenniśi \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. The eight sticks should be inspired with great mantram described by Garuda. The ground should be dug twenty one times in the night.

## \|\| 20.10 \|\|

*vidyunmūṣakavajrādisamupadrava eva ca \|*  
*harakṣamalavarayū binduyuktaḥ sadāśivaḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. This will ward of the dangers proceeding from lightning, mouse, and thunder-bolt. The mantram is: Нага, Ksara, Amala, Vasat, added with Vindu Sadasiva.

## \|\| 20.11 \|\|

*oṃ hrāṃ sadāśivāya namaḥ \|*  
*tarjanyā vinyasetpiṇḍaṃ (ṇḍe) dāḍimīkusumaprabham \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Om. Bram, salutation unto Sadasiva. He should then assign Pinda (balls of rice) effulgent like Dadima flowers with the forefinger.

## \|\| 20.12 \|\|

*tasyaiva darśanādduṣṭā meghavidyuddipādayaḥ \|*  
*rākṣasā bhūtaḍākinyaḥ pradravanti diśo daśa \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. By seeing it the evil clouds, lightning and other enemies viz. the Raksasas, goblins and female ghosts fly away into the ten quarters.

## \|\| 20.13 \|\|

*oṃ hrīṃ gaṇeśāya namaḥ \|*  
*(oṃ hrīṃ) stambhanādicakrāya namaḥ \|*  
*oṃ aiṃ brahayaintrai lokyaḍāmarāya namaḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Om. Hrim, salutation unto Ganesa. Om, Hrim, salutation unto the cakra of Stambhana. Om, om, salutation into the Damaras of the three worlds.

## \|\| 20.14 \|\|

*bhairavaṃ piṇḍamākhyātaṃ viṣapāpagrahāpaham \|*  
*kṣetrasya rakṣaṇaṃ bhūtarākṣasādeḥ pramardanam \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. This pinda is called Bhairava which counteracts the effect of poison and the evil effects of the hostile planets. It protects the field and grinds the goblins and Raksasas. Om. Namah.

## \|\| 20.15 \|\|

*oṃ namaḥ \|*  
*indravajraṃ kare dhyātvā duṣṭameghādivāraṇam \|*  
*viṣa śatrugaṇā bhūtā naśyante vajramudrayā \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Having meditated on the thunder-holt О his hand he should ward of the evil influence of wicked clouds and with Vajra Mudra all the ghosts, the enemies with poison.

## \|\| 20.16 \|\|

*oṃ kṣuṃ(kṣa) namaḥ \|*  
*smaretpāśaṃ vāmahaste viṣabhūtādi naśyati \|*  
*oṃ hrāṃ (hro) namaḥ \|*  
*hareduccāraṇānmantro viṣameghagrahādikān \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. Om, Ksum, Namah. He should meditate on his left hand. It destroys all venomous creatures. Om, Hram, Namah. The very recitation of this mantram destroys the evil clouds and stars.

## \|\| 20.17 \|\|

*dhyātvā kṛtāntaṃ ca dahecchedakāstreṇa vai jagat \|*  
*oṃ kṣṇaṃ (kṣma) namaḥ \|*  
*dhyātvā tu bhairavaṃ kuryāndrahabhūtaviṣāpaham \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Having meditated on death he should consume the universe with the destroying weapon. Om, Ksrha (Ksam), Namah. Meditating on Bhairava one should remove the evil influences of stars, goblins and poison.

## \|\| 20.18 \|\|

*oṃ lasaddijihvākṣa svāhā \|*  
*kṣetrādau grahabhūtādiviṣapakṣinivāraṇam \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. Om, lasat, Jihvaksa Svaha. This mantram destroys the enemies of the field viz, the evil stars, goblins, poison and birds.

## \|\| 20.19 \|\|

*oṃ kṣva (kṣṇaṃ) namaḥ \|*  
*raktena paṭahe likhya śabdātresurgrahādayaḥ \|*  
*oṃ mara mara mārayamāraya svāhā \|*  
*oṃ huṃ phaṭ svāhā \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Ош Ksam Namah. The figure of a cistern should be drawn with blood and then the names of planets should be written there. Ош, Mara, Mara, Maraya, Maraya Svaha. Om, Hum, Phat, Svaha.

## \|\| 20.20 \|\|

*śūlaṃ cāṣṭaśatairmantrya bhrāmaṇācchatruvṛndahṛt \|*  
*ūrdhaśaktinipātena adhaḥ śaktiṃ nikuñceyet \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. The dart should be inspired mentally with eight hundrep mantrams. It destroys all the enemies. With higher energies the lower ones should be suppressed.

## \|\| 20.21 \|\|

*pūrake pūritā mantrāḥ kumbhakena sumantritāḥ \|*  
*praṇavenāpyāyitāste manavastadudīritāḥ \|*  
*evamāpyāyitā mantrā bhṛtyavatphaladāyakāḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. Then the mantrams should be practises in Puraka1 and should be again well inspired in Kumbhaka2. They should then be received with Pranava. When the man trams and thus properly received and used they yield fruts like servants.

## Chapter 21

## \|\| 21.1 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*pañcavatkrārcanaṃ vakṣye pṛtha gyadbhuktimuktidam \|*  
*oṃ bhūrviṣṇave ādibhūtāya sarvādhārāya mūrtaye svāhā \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Suta said: — I will now describes separately the adoration of Pancavaktra (five mouths) which yeilds enjoyment and emancipation. Om bhur \[salutation unto\] Visnu, the first bhuta, the stay of all, unto him having a form, Svaha.

## \|\| 21.2-3 \|\|

*sadyojātasya cāhvānamanena prathamaṃ caret \|*  
*oṃ hāṃ sadyojātāyaiva kalā hyaṣṭau prakīrtitāḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

*siddhirṛddhirdhṛtirlakṣmīrmedhā kāntiḥ svadhā sthitiḥ (8) \|*  
*oṃ hīṃ vāmadevāyaiva kalāstasya trayodaśa \|\| 3 \|\|*

2-3. First of all with this mantram invocation of Sadyajata (Siva) should be made. Om, Ham salutation unto Sadyojata. His kalas (parts) are eight in number viz. Siddhi, Rddhi, Dhrti, LaksmI, Medha, Kanti, Svadha, Sthiti.

## \|\| 21.4 \|\|

*rajā rakṣā ratiḥ pālyā kānti stṛṣṇā matiḥ kriyā \|*  
*kāmā buddhiśca rātriśca trāsanī mohinī tathā (13) \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Om, Hum, salutation unto Vamadeva, His kalas are thirteen in number, viz. Raja, Raksa, Rati, Palya, Kanti, Trsna, Mati, Kriya, Buddhi, Rati, Trasanl, and Mohinl.

## \|\| 21.5 \|\|

*manonmanī aghorā ca tathā mohā kṣudhā kalāḥ \|*  
*nidrā mṛtyuśca māyā ca (8)aṣṭasaṃkhyā bhayaṅkara \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Manonmani, Aghora, Moha, Ksudha, Nidra, Mrtyu, Maya — these are the eight dreadful Kalas.

## \|\| 21.6 \|\|

*oṃ haiṃ tatpuruṣāyaiva (ṣāya) nivṛttiśca pratiṣṭhā ca vidyā śāntirna kevalā \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Om, Hraim, salutation unto Tatapurusa. His Kalas are Nivrthi, Pratisiha, Vidya, Santi and Kevala.

## \|\| 21.7 \|\|

*oṃ hauṃ īśānāya namo niścalā ca nirañjanā \|*  
*śaśinī cāṅganā caiva marīcirjvālinī tathā \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Om, Hroum: salutation unto Isana.His kalas are Niscata, Niranjana, Sasini, Angana, Marlci and Jvalini.

## Chapter 22

## \|\| 22.1 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*śivārcanaṃ pravakṣyāmi buktimuktikaraṃ param \|*  
*śāntaṃ sarvagataṃ śūnyaṃ mātrādvādaśake sthitam \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Suta said: — I will now describe the great adoration of Shiva which yeilds enjoyment and emancipation. He is of a quiescent soul, present every where, void and stationed in a room of twelve parts.

## \|\| 22.2-3 \|\|

*pañca vakkrāṇi hrasvāni dīrghāṇyaṅgāni bindunā \|*  
*savisargaṃ vadedastraṃ śiva ūrghvaṃ tathā punaḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

*ṣaṣṭhenādho mahāmantro haumityevākhilārthadaḥ \|*  
*hastābhyāṃ saṃspṛśetpādāvūrdhvaṃ pādānmastakam \|\| 3 \|\|*

2-3. His five mouths are represented by five short vowels and his limbs by leng vowels added with Vindu. His weapon is represented by Visarga. Then the word Shiva should be written upwards with the sixth the great mantram Houm impregnated with various meanings should be written. With hands the after parts of the feet should be held then the ends thereof should be placed on the head.

## \|\| 22.4 \|\|

*mahāmudrā hi sarveṣāṃ karāṅganyāsamācaret \|*  
*tālahastena pṛṣṭhaṃ ca astramantreṇa śodhayet \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. This is the great Mudra. Then the assignment of hands should be made. With the astra mantram the back should be purified.

## \|\| 22.5 \|\|

*kaniṣṭhāmāditaḥ kṛtvā tarjanyaṅgāni vinyaset \|*  
*pūjanaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi karṇikāyāṃ tdṛdambuje \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Then beginning with the youngest finger and ending with the fore all the figers should be assigned. I will now describe the adoration in the pericarp of the lotus of the heart.

## \|\| 22.6 \|\|

*dharmaṃ jñānaṃ ca vairāgyamaiśvaryādi tdṛdārcayet \|*  
*āvāhanaṃ sthāpanaṃ ca pādyamarghyaṃ hṛdārpayet \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. One should adore religion, knowledge, disassociation from the world and prosperity in the heart. The invocation and the installation \[rites of the Deity\], the water for washing feet and Arghya should be dedicated to the heart.

## \|\| 22.7 \|\|

*ācāmaṃ snapanaṃ pūjāmekādhāraṇatulyakam? \|*  
*agnikāryavidhiṃ vakṣye astreṇollekhanaṃ caret \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. And similarly the rinsing the mouth, sprinkling of water and adoration should be made. I will now describe the rites of fire worship. They should be written with the astra mantram.

## \|\| 22.8-17 \|\|

*varṃmaṇābhyukṣaṇaṃ kāryaṃ śaktinyāsaṃ hṛdā caret \|*  
*tdṛdi vā śaktigarte ca prakṣipejjātavedasam \|\| 8 \|\|*

*garbhādhānādikaṃ kṛtvā niṣkṛtiṃ cārasya paścimām \|*  
*hṛdā kṛtvā sarvakarṃma śivaṃ sāṃgaṃ tu homayet \|\| 9 \|\|*

*pūjayenmaṇḍale śambhuṃ padmagarbhe garāṅkitam \|*  
*catuḥ ṣaṣṭyantamaṣṭādi khākṣi khādyādimaṇḍalam \|\| 10 \|\|*

*khākṣīndrasūryagaṃ sarvakhādivedendu (devendu) vartanam \|*  
*āgneyyāṃ kārayetkuṇḍamardhacandranibhaṃ śubham \|\| 11 \|\|*

*agniśāstra parāyustho tdṛdayādigaṇocyate \|*  
*astraṃ diśā supadmasya karṇikāyāṃ sadāśivaḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

*dīkṣāṃ vakṣye pañcatattve sthitāṃ bhūmyādikāṃ pare \|*  
*nivṛttirbhūpratiṣṭhādyairvidyāgniḥ śāntivannijaḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

*śāntyatītaṃ bhavevdyoma tatparaṃ śāntamavyayam \|*  
*ekaikasya śataṃ homā hatyevaṃ pañca homayet \|\| 14 \|\|*

*paścātpūrṇāhutiṃ dattvā prā(pra)sodana śivaṃ smaret \|*  
*prāyaścittaviśuddhyarthamekaikāṣṭāhutiṃ kramāt \|\| 15 \|\|*

*homayedastrabījena evaṃ dīkṣāṃ samāpayet \|*  
*yajanavyatirekeṇa gopyaṃ saṃskāramuttamam \|\| 16 \|\|*

*evaṃ saṃskāraśuddhasya śivatvaṃ jāyate dhruvam \|\| 17 \|\|*

8-17. Then the coat of mail should be sprinkled with water. And &akti shold be assigend to the heart. Then he should place fire either in the heart or in the pit for &akti. Having performed the Garbhadhana he should celebrate the other rites. Afterwards having assigned to the heart the freedom from all those rites as well as all other rites he should perform Нота for Shiva and all th members of his family. Then in a diagram having the figure of a lotus drawn inside it he should worship the bull-emblemed deity 6ambhu.

## Chapter 23

## \|\| 23.1 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*śivārcanaṃ pravakṣyāmi dharṃmakāmādisādhanam \|*  
*tribhirmantrairācāmettu svāhāntaiḥ praṇavādikaiḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Suta said: — I will describe the adoration of Siva by which religious profit, desire etc. are secured. With three mantrams beginning with Om and ending with Svaha the mouth be rinsed with water.

## \|\| 23.2 \|\|

*oṃ hāṃ ātmatattvāya vidyātattvāya hīṃ tathā \|*  
*oṃ hūṃ śivatattvāya svāhā hṛdā syācchrotravandanam \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Om, Ham salutation into the principle of self. Hrim, salutation unto the principle of leargning. Om, Hum salutation unto the principle of Shiva Swaha., The ears should, be closed with the heart.

## \|\| 23.3 \|\|

*bhasmasnānaṃ tarpaṇaṃ ca oṃ hāṃ svāhā sarvamantrakāḥ \|*  
*sarve devāḥ sarvamunirnamo 'nto vauṣaḍantakaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. От, Ham, Yam, Swaha are the mantrams for bathing with ashes and offering oblations of water. All the gods and all the Munis should be adored with the mantram "Salutation Vhousat".

## \|\| 23.4 \|\|

*svadhāntāḥ sarvapitaraḥ svadhāntāśca pitāmahāḥ \|*  
*oṃ hāṃ prapitāmahebhyastathā mātāmahādayaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. All the Pitrs and all the Pitammahas (patriarchs) should be adored with mantrams ending with the word Svadha. Om, Ham, alutation unto the great grad-fathers. The same is for the maternal grand-father.

## \|\| 23.5 \|\|

*hāṃ namaḥ sarvamātṛbhyastataḥ syātprāṇasaṃyamaḥ \|*  
*ācāmaṃ mārjanaṃ cātho gāyatrīṃ ca japettataḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. \[The next is\] Ham, salutation unto all the Matrs. Then the vital, airs should be suppressed Then he should rinse his mouth with water, rub his body his recite the Gayatri \[which is as follows\].

## \|\| 23.6 \|\|

*oṃ hāṃ tanmaheśāya vidmahe.vāgviśuddhāya dhīmahi. tanno rudraḥ pracodayāt \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Om, Ham, Tam Mahesaya Vidmahe, Vagvisudhaya Dhlmahi Tanno Rudrah Pracodayat.

## \|\| 23.7 \|\|

*sūryopasthānakaṃ kṛtvā sūryamantraiḥ prapūjayet \|*
