Takram (a kind of whey), whose creamy substance has beenremoved, subdues the three Dosas and cures lienteric diarrhoea, oedema, haemorrhoids Jaundice, dysentery and effects of any slow poison retained in the system.

## \|\| 169.45 \|\|

*vṛṣyañca madhuraṃ sarpirvātapittakaphāpaham \|*  
*gavyaṃ medhyañca cākṣuṣyaṃ saṃskārācca tridoṣajit \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. Clarified butter (Ghrtam) is sweet, constructive, nerve-tonic, anticholeric and phlegmagougic; Ghrtam made out of cow titter improves the intellect and eye-sight, while a properly prepared and medicated Ghrtam serves to destroy the three Dosas.

## \|\| 169.46 \|\|

*apasmāragadonmādamūrchāghnaṃ saṃskṛtaṅghṛtam \|*  
*ajādīnāñca sarpoṣi vidyādgokṣīrasadguṇaiḥ \|*  
*kaphavātaharaṃ mūtraṃ sarvakrimiviṣāpaham \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. Old Ghrtam proves curative in hysteria, insanity, and epileptic fits. Ghrtam made out of goat's butter, or of any other butter should be regarded as possessing identical virtues with that milk. Urine is an antitoxic vermifuge and subdues the deranged Kapham and Vayu.

## \|\| 169.47 \|\|

*pāṇḍutvodarakuṣṭhārśaḥ śothagulmapramehanut \|*  
*vātaśleṣmaharaṃ balyaṃ tailaṃ kaśyaṃ tilodbhavam \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. Sesame oil is tonic, improves the growth of hair, subdues the deranged Vayu and Kapham, and proves beneficial in Jaundice, Ascitis, cutaneous affections, haemorhoids, oedema, intestinal glands and urinary complaints.

## \|\| 169.48 \|\|

*sārṣapaṃ kṛmipāṇḍughnaṃ kaphamedo 'nilāpaham \|*  
*kṣaumaṃ tailamacakṣuṣyaṃ pittahṛdvātanāśanam \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. Mustard oil is anti-corpulent, vermi- fuginous, and phlegmagougic and cures Jaundice and the deranged Vayu. Linseed oil impairs digestion, and destroys the Vayu and Pittam.

## \|\| 169.49 \|\|

*akṣajaṃ kaphapittaghnaṃ keśyaṃ tvakśrotratarpaṇam \|*  
*tridoṣaghnaṃ madhu proktaṃ vātalañca prakīrtitam \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. Oil expressed out of Aksa seeds is anticholeric, and phlegmagoguic, it improves the growth of hair and soothes the skin and the eyes.

## \|\| 169.50 \|\|

*hikkāśvāsakṛmicchardimehatṛṣṇāviṣāmaham \|*  
*ikṣavoraktapittaghno balyā vṛṣyāḥ kaphapradāḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. Honey destroys the three Dosas, and generate Vayu in the system, and proves curative in hiccough, bronchitis, vomiting, urinary complaints, thirst, intestinal worms and effects of poisoning. Sugarcane is tonic and constructive, generates the Kapharn, and cures haemorrhage, hymoptisis, etc.

## \|\| 169.51 \|\|

*phāṇitaṃ pittalaṃ tavriṃ surā matsyaṇḍikā laghuḥ \|*  
*khaṇḍaṃ vṛṣyaṃ tathā snigdhaṃ svādvasṛkpittavātajit \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. Phanitam (boiled sugarcane juice) is sharp and Pitta-generating, while Matsyandika (surface layer of treacle) is white and light, and Khanda (a kind of unrefined sugar) is emoilent, constructive, and sweet, and proves curative in haemorrhages and disorders of the Vayu.

## \|\| 169.52 \|\|

*vātapittaharo rūkṣo vātaghnaḥ kaphakṛdguḍaḥ \|*  
*sa pittaghnaḥ paraḥ pathyaḥ purāṇo 'sṛkprasādanaḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. Treacle is constructive, Kaphah-generating and Vayu and Pitta-subduing. Old treacle is extremely wholesome, subdues the Pittam and soothes the blood.

## \|\| 169.53 \|\|

*raktipittaharā vṛṣyā sasnehā gaḍaśarkarā \|*  
*sarvapittakaraṃ madyamamlatvātkaphavātajit \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. Treacle-sugar is constructive and cures haemorrhage, hymoptisis, etc. All kinds of urine generate the Pittam, which, through its acid taste, conquers the Kapham and Vayu.

## \|\| 169.54 \|\|

*raktapittakarāstīkṣṇāstathā sauvīrajātayaḥ \|*  
*pācano dīpanaḥ pathyo maṇḍaḥ syādbhṛṣṭataṇḍulaḥ \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. Wines of the Sauvlra species are sharp and aggravate blood and the Pitta. Manda made of fried rice is appetising and digestant.

## \|\| 169.55-56 \|\|

*vātānulomanī laghvī peyā vastiviśodhanī \|*  
*satakradāḍimavyoṣā saguḍā madhupippalī \|\| 55 \|\|*

*intīyaṃ sukṛtā peyā kāsaśvā sapravāhikāḥ \|*  
*pāyasaḥ kaphakṛdbalyaḥ kṛśarā vātanāśinī \|\| 56 \|\|*

55-56. Peya (gruel) is light, diuretic and restores the deranged Vayu to its normal condition. Peyas made with whey, pomegranate, and Vyosa, or with treacle, Amala and Pippall prove curative in cough, bronchitis and diarrhoea. Payasa is tonic and phlegmagoguic, Krcchra, is Vayu-destroying.

## \|\| 169.57 \|\|

*sudhautaḥ prastrutaḥ snigdhaḥ sukhoṣṇo laghurocanaḥ \|*  
*kandamūlaphalehaiḥ sādhito bṛṃhaṇoguruḥ \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. Soup being cooked in combination with bulbs, roots, fruit or Ghrtam becomes heavy and constructive.

## \|\| 169.58 \|\|

*īṣaduṣṇasevanācca laghuḥ sūpaḥ susādhitaḥ \|*  
*svinna niṣpīḍitaṃ śākaṃ hitaṃ snehādisaṃskṛtam \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. A Supa (salted soup), well-cOoked and taken lukewarm, forms a light diet. 5akas, wellcooked and with their watery parts squeezed out, and seasoned with any oily or fatty substance, forms a uholesome dish.

## \|\| 169.59 \|\|

*dāḍimāmalakairyūṣo vahnikṛdvātapittahā \|*  
*śvāsakāsapratiśyāyakaphaghno malakaiḥ kṛtaḥ \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. Jusa (unsalted soup) made with Amalaka and pomegranate improves digestion, destroys the Vayu and Pittam; made with Mulaka it proves efficacious in cough, bronchitis, catarrh and diseases of the deranged Kapham.

## \|\| 169.60 \|\|

*yavakolakulatthānāṃ yūṣaḥ kaṇṭhyo 'nilāpahaḥ \|*  
*mudgāmalakajo grāhī śleṣmapittavināśanaḥ \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. Jusa of barley, Kola and Kulattha pulse is beneficial to the voice and subdues the deranged Vayu. Juice made with Amalaka and Mu,dgapulse is astringent and conquers the deranged Kapha and Pittam.

## \|\| 169.61 \|\|

*saguḍaṃ dadhi vātaghnaṃ saktavo rūkṣavātulāḥ \|*  
*ghṛtapūrṇo 'gnikārī syādvṛṣyā gurvo ca śaṣkulī \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. Milk-curd with treacle is Vayu-destroying. fried barley-powder (Shaktu) is parchifying and Vayu generating, 6uskalis (something like Kacauries) prepared with Ghrtam are aphrodisiac and heavy (of digestion), and improve the digestive faculty.

## \|\| 169.62 \|\|

*bṛṃhaṇāḥ sāmiṣā bhakṣyapiṣṭa kā gukhaḥ smṛtāḥ \|*  
*tailasiddhāśca dṛṣṭighnāstoyasvinnāśca durjarāḥ \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. Articles of fare made with cooked meat are constructive and tissue building; cakes are heavy of digestion, those, which are baked with oil, impair the eye sight, while those which are boiled with water are extremely hard to digest.

## \|\| 169.63 \|\|

*atyuṣṇā maṇḍakāḥ pathyāḥ śītalā gukho matāḥ \|*  
*anupānañca pānīyaṃ śramatṛṣṇādināśanam \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. Warm Mandakas are extremely wholesome; cold they take a long time to be digested. Drinks and after potions (Anupinas) are refrigerant, and those, who follow the proper rules as regards drinks and Anupanas, know no disease and enjoy a sort of immunity from poisoning.

## \|\| 169.64 \|\|

*annapānādinā rakṣā kṛtsyādrogavarjitaḥ \|*  
*anuṣṇaḥ śikhikaṇṭhābho viṣañcaiva vivarṇakṛt \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. The taste or touch of a cold poison, resembling the neck of a peacock in colour, produces mental anguish and discolouring of the complexion of a patient anywise handling it.

## \|\| 169.65 \|\|

*gandhasparśarasāstīvrābhoktuśca syānmanovyathā \|*  
*āghrāṇe cākṣirogaḥ syādasādhyaśca bhiṣagvaraiḥ \|*  
*vepathurjṛmbhaṇādyaṃ syādviṣasyaitattu lakṣaṇam \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. The smell of such a poison produces obstinate occular affections, yawning, shivering, etc., which baffle the skill of even the best of physicians.

## Chapter 170

## \|\| 170.1 \|\|

*dhanvantariruvāca \|*  
*jvaro 'ṣṭadhā pṛthagdvandvasaṃghātāgantujaḥ smṛtaḥ \|*  
*mustaparpaṭakośīracandanodīcyanāgaraiḥ \|*  
*śṛtaśītaṃ jalaṃ dadyātpipāsājvaraśāntaye \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Dhanvantari said: — There are eight forms of fever, in consideration of their Dosa-born or traumatic nature, as well as of cases in which the deranged Vayu, Pittam, and Kapha act in couples or in entire concert. Water cooked with Musta, Parpata, Usira, Candana, Udici and Nagara and subsequently cooled down should be given to a fever-patient for the alleviation of heat and thirst.

## \|\| 170.2 \|\|

*nāgaraṃ devakāṣṭhañca dhānyākaṃ bṛhatīdvayam \|*  
*dadyātpācanakaṃ pūrvaṃ jvaritāya jvarāpaham \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. A febrifuge decoction of Nagaram, Deva- daru, Dhanyakam, Vrhati and Kantakari should be given to a fever patient.

## \|\| 170.3 \|\|

*āragvadhābhayāmustātiktāgranthikanirmitaḥ \|*  
*kaṣāyaḥ pācanaḥ sāme saśūle ca jvarehitaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. A decoction (Pacanam) of the Aragvadha, Musta, Tikta, and Granthika proves efficacious during the immatuse stage of fever attended with colic.

## \|\| 170.4 \|\|

*madhūkasārasindhūtthavacoṣaṇakaṇāḥ samāḥ \|*  
*ślakṣṇaṃ piṣṭvāmbhasā nasyaṃ kuryātsaṃjñāprabodhanam \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. A compound of Madhuka pith, Sindhutha, Vaca, Usana, and Капа taken in equal parts and pounded together should be given as an errhine for rousing up the patient from an unconscious state.

## \|\| 170.5 \|\|

*trivṛdviśālātriphalākaṭukāragvadhaiḥ kṛtaḥ \|*  
*sakṣāro bhedanaḥ kvāthaḥ peyaḥ sarvajvarāpahaḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. A purgative decoction of Trivsda, Visala, Triphala, Katuka and Aragvadha, saturated with an alkali, proves curative in all types of fever.

## \|\| 170.6 \|\|

*mahauṣadhāmṛtāmustacandanośīradhānyakaiḥ \|*  
*kvāthastṛtīyakaṃ hanti śarkarāmadhuyojitaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. A decoction of Mahausadha, Amrta, Musta, Candana, Usira, and Dhanyakam, administered with the addition of sugar and honey, cures tertian ague.

## \|\| 170.7 \|\|

*apāmagajaṭākaṭyāṃ lohitaiḥ saptatantubhiḥ \|*  
*baddhvā vāre ravernūnaṃ jvaraṃ hanti tṛtīyakam \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Clusters of Aparmarga flowers tied with seven strings of red thread round the waist of a patient on a Sunday, cures tertian ague (Trtlyakam).

## \|\| 170.8 \|\|

*gaṅgāyā uttare kūle aputrastāpaso mṛtaḥ \|*  
*tasmai tilodakaṃ dadyānmuñcatyaikāhiko jvaraḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. A recitation of the Mantra, "a sonless ascetic died on the north bank of the Ganges, I offer libations of water with sesame seeds unto him," proves curative in Aikahika form of intermitent fever.

## \|\| 170.9 \|\|

*guḍūcyāḥ kvāthakalkābhyāṃ viphalāvāsakasya ca \|*  
*mṛdvīkāyā balāyāśca siddhāḥ snehā jvaracchidaḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. A Ghrtam properly cooked with the expressed juice and paste of GuducI, Triphala, Vrsa, Mrdvlka and Vala acts as a good febrifuge.

## \|\| 170.10 \|\|

*dhātrīśivākaṇāvahnikvāthaḥ sarvajvarāntakaḥ \|*  
*jvarātisāraharaṇamauṣadhaṃ pravadāmyatha \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. Similarly, a decoction of Dhatri, Shiva, Капа and Vanhi cures all forms of fever. Now hear me discourse on the drug-compounds, which prove remedial to Jvaratisara (fever with dysentery).

## \|\| 170.11 \|\|

*pṛśriparṇobalāvilvanāgarotpaladhānyakaiḥ \|*  
*pāṭhendrayavabhūnimbamustaparpaṭakaiḥ śṛtāḥ \|*  
*jyantyāmamatīsāraṃ sajvaraṃ samahauṣadhāḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. A decoction of PrsnI-parni, Vala, Vilva, Nagaram, Utpalam, Dhanyakam, Patha, Indrayava, Bhunimba, Musta, Parpata and Mahaus adham cures fever with mucous dysentery.

## \|\| 170.12 \|\|

*nāgarātiviṣāmustabhūnimbāmṛtavatsakaiḥ \|*  
*sarvajvaraharaḥ kvathaḥ sarvātīsāranāśanaḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. A decoction of Nagaram Ativisa, Musta, Bhunimva, and Vatsaka proves curative in all forms of fever and dysentery.

## \|\| 170.13-14 \|\|

*mustaparpaṭakadivyaśṛṅgaveraśṛtaṃ payaḥ \|*  
*śālaparṇo pṛśriparṇo bṛhatī kaṇṭakārikā \|\| 13 \|\|*

*balāśvadaṃṣṭrābilvādi pāṭhānāgaradhānyakam \|*  
*etadāhārasaṃyoge hitaṃ sarvātisāriṇām \|\| 14 \|\|*

13-14. Water boiled and cooked with Musta, Parpataka, Udlcya, and Shrngavera, and subsequently cooled down, may be advantageously give as a drink in all forms of dysentery. Similarly, Shalaparn I, Prsnlparn I, the two kinds of Vrhati, Kantakarika, Vala, Svadans tra, Bilva, Patha, Nagara, and Dhanyakam may be administered with diet in all forms of the same disease.

## \|\| 170.15 \|\|

*bilvacūtāsthikvāthaśca khaṇḍaṃ madhvatisāranut \|*  
*atisāre hitā tadvatkuṭajatvakkaṇāyutā \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Bela fruits or the inner pulps of mango- stones, taken with treacle or honey, or Kutaja bark taken with Капа proves beneficial in dysentery.

## \|\| 170.16 \|\|

*vatsakātiviṣāviśvakaṇākandakaṣāyakaḥ \|*  
*prayuktaścāmaśūlāḍhye hyatīsāre saśoṇita \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. A decoction of Vatsaka, Ativisa, Vilva, Капа and Ksayaka cures dysentery with bloody mucous stool, attended with an extreme griping pain.

## \|\| 170.17 \|\|

*cikitsātha grahaṇyāstugrahaṇī cāgrināśinī \|*  
*citrakākvāthaklakābhyāṃ grahaṇīghnaṃ kṣṛtaṃ haviḥ \|*  
*gulmaśothodaraplīhaśūlārśoghnaṃ pradīpanam \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Now hear me discourse on the therapeutics of Grahini (lienteric diarrhoea) Grahini results from the impairment of the digestive faculty. A medicated Ghrtam cooked with the paste and decoctiong of Citrakam is appetising, and proves curative in intestinal glands, oedema, ascites, splenic enlargement, colic and haemorrhoids.

## \|\| 170.18 \|\|

*sauvarcalaṃ saindhavañca viḍaṅgaudbhidameva ca \|*  
*sāmudreṇa samaṃ pañcalavaṇānyatra yojayet \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. The five kinds of salt such as the Sauvarcala, Saindhavam, Vidanga, Audbhidam, and Samudram should be added to the foregoing medicine.

## \|\| 170.19 \|\|

*bheṣajaṃ śastrakṣārāgnyastridhā vai cārśasāṃ haram \|*  
*viddhi taccārśasoghnantu yaddhi takraṃ navoddhṛtam \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Medicines, surgical operations, and potential and actual cauteries are the four remedies to be resorted to for the purposes of curing piles. Newly made Takram (a kind of whey) proves remedial to piles.

## \|\| 170.20 \|\|

*guḍūṭīṃ pippalīyuktāmabhayāṃ ghṛtabharjitām \|*  
*trivṛdarśovināśārthaṃ bhakṣayedamlaloṇikām \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. Pippall taken with treacle, Haritakls fried with clarirfied butter, or Trivrt with acid Lonika may be used with advantage in piles.

## \|\| 170.21 \|\|

*tilekṣurasasaṃyogaścārśaḥ kuṣṭha vināśanaḥ \|*  
*pañcakolaṃ samaricaṃ satryūṣaṇamathāgnikṛt \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. A compound of sugar-cane juice and sesame proves beneficial in piles and cutaneous affections. A decoction of the Mcakola group of drugs with Marica and Tryusanam improves the digestive faculty.

## \|\| 170.22 \|\|

*harītakī bhakṣyamāṇā nāgeraṇa guḍena vā \|*  
*saindhavopahitā vāpi sātatyenāgnidīpanī \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. Haritakis, taken with Nagaram, treacle or rocksalt, are extremely appetising and stomachic.

## \|\| 170.23 \|\|

*phalatrikāmṛtāsātiktābhūnimbanimbajaḥ \|*  
*kvāthaḥ kṣaudrayuto hanyātpāṇḍurogaṃ sakāmalam \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. A decoction of Triphala, Amrta, Vasa, Tikta, Bhunimba, and Nimbaja taken with honey cures Jaundice and Chlorosis.

## \|\| 170.24 \|\|

*trivṛcca triphalā śyāmā pippalī śarkaga madhu \|*  
*modakaḥ sannipātānto raktapittajvarāpahaḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. A confection prepared with Trivrt, Triphala. Syama, Pippall, sugar and honey cures haemoptisis and Sannipatika forms of fever.

## \|\| 170.25-26 \|\|

*vāsāyāṃ vidyamānāyāmāśāyāṃ jīvitasya ca \|*  
*raktapittī kṣayī kāsī kimarthamavasīdati \|\| 25 \|\|*

*āṭarūpakamṛdvīkāpathyākvāthaḥ saśarkaraḥ \|*  
*kṣaudrāḍhyaḥ kāsaniḥ śvāsaraktapittanibarhaṇaḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

25-26. As long as there exists a Vasa plant in this word, why should a haemoptisis, bronchitis, cough or pthisis patient despair of his life. A decoction of Atarusaka, Mrdvlka, and Pathya taken with sugar and honey proves remedial to cough, bronchitis, and haemoptisis.

## \|\| 170.27 \|\|

*vāsārasaḥ khaṇḍamadhuyutaḥ pīto 'tharaktajit \|*  
*sallakībadarījambupriyālāmrārjunaṃ dhavaḥ \|*  
*pītaṃ kṣīrañca madhvāḍhyaṃ pṛthakchoṇitavāraṇam \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. The expressed juice of Vasa, taken with sugar and honey arrests haemorrhage. The expressed juice of Sallaki, Vadari, Jambu, Priyala, Amra, Arjunam, and Dhava, severally taken with honey and alkali, execises a styptic virtue.

## \|\| 170.28 \|\|

*samūlaphalapatrāyā nirguṇḍyāḥ svarasairghṛtam \|*  
*siddhaṃ pītvā kṣayakṣīṇī nirvyādirbhāti devavat \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. A patient suffering from ulcerative endocarditis, by taking a Ghrtam, cooked and medicated with the expressed juice of the bark and leaves of Nirgundl, gets rid of the disease and acquires a godly health.

## \|\| 170.29 \|\|

*harītakī kaṇā śuṇṭhī maricaṃ guḍasaṃyutam \|*  
*kāsaghno modakaḥ proktastṛṣṇārocakanāśanaḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. A confection made of Haritaki, Капа, hunt hi, Marica and treacle, removes cough, thirst and a distaste for food.

## \|\| 170.30 \|\|

*kaṇṭakāriguḍūcībhyāṃ pṛthaktriṃśatpale rase \|*  
*prasthaṃ siddhaṃ ghṛtaṃ syācca kāsanudvahnidāpanam \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. A Prastha measure of Ghrtam cooked with a thirty Pala weight each of the expressed juice of Kantakari and Guduci cures cough and improves the digestives faculty.

## \|\| 170.31 \|\|

*kṛṣṇā dhātrī śitā śuṇṭhī hakkāghnī madhusaṃyutā \|*  
*hikkāśvāsī pivedbhārṅgo saviśvāmuṣṇavāriṇā \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. A decoction of Krsna, Dhatrl, Sid and Sunthi, taken with honey, cures hic-cough, whereas a patient suffering from asthma should take BhargI and Viva through the medium of warm water.

## \|\| 170.32 \|\|

*tailāktaṃ svarabhede vā khādiraṃ dhārayenmukhe \|*  
*pathyāṃ pippalikāyuktāṃ saṃyuktāṃ nāgareṇa vā \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. A person suffering from hoarseness, should keep catechu soaked in oil or powdered Pippali and Pathya, or Pathya and Nagaram in his mouth.

## \|\| 170.33 \|\|

*viḍaṅgatrilācūrṇaṃ chardihṛnmadhunā saha \|*  
*āmrajambūkaṣāyaṃ vā pibonmākṣikasaṃyutam \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. A powdered compound of Vidanga, Triphala and Vigva taken with honey arrests vomiting, or a decoction of Amra or Jambu may be taken with Maksikam for that end.

## \|\| 170.34 \|\|

*chardi sarvāṃ praṇudati tṛṣṇāñcaivāpakarṣati \|*  
*triphalā bhramamūrchāhṛtpītā sā madhunāpi vā \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. The last named compound allays thirst and arrests vomiting, Triphala taken with honey or milk conquers vertigo, epileptic fits, etc.

## \|\| 170.35 \|\|

*pañcagavyaṃ hitaṃ pānādapasmāragrahādinut \|*  
*kūṣmāṇḍakaraso vājyaṃ sayaṣṭikaṃ tadarthakṛt \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. Potions of Pancagavyam are remedial to hysteria and diseases due to the influences of malignant planets. Ghrtam medicated with the expressed juice of Kusmanda and Yasthikam possesses the same efficacy.

## \|\| 170.36-37 \|\|

*brāhmīrasavacākuṣṭhaśaṅkhapuṣpībhireva ca \|*  
*purāṇaṃ sevyamunmādagrahāpasmāradghṛnutam \|\| 36 \|\|*

*aśvagandhākaṣāye ca kalke kṣīre caturguṇe \|*  
*ghṛtapakvantu vātaghnaṃ vṛṣyaṃ māṃ sāya putrakṛt \|\| 37 \|\|*

36-37. Old Ghrtam medicated with the addition of Vaca, Kustham, Shankhapuspl, and the expressed juice of Brahml cures insanity and the nervous diseases known as Grahapsmara. A medicinal Ghrtam cooked with the expressed juice of ASvagandha and four times as much milk is constructive, aphrodisiac, and remedial to nervous diseases and sterility.

## \|\| 170.38 \|\|

*nīlīmuṇḍīrikācūrṇaṃ madhusarpiḥ samanvitam \|*  
*chinnākvāthaṃ pibanhanti vātaraktaṃ sudustaram \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. Powders of Nill and Mundarika taken with honey and clarfied butter, as well as the decoction of Chinna creeper proves curative in the worst type of Vataraktam.'

## \|\| 170.39 \|\|

*saguḍāḥ pañca pathyāśca kuṣṭārśovātasādanāḥ \|*  
*gaḍacīsvarasaṃ kalkaṃ cūrṇaṃ vā kvāthameva vā \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. Five Harltakls taken with treacle cure nervous diseases and cutaneous affections; the paste, powder, or decoction of Guduci possesses the same efficacy.

## \|\| 170.40 \|\|

*vātaraktāntakaṃ kālāguḍūcīkvāthakalkataḥ \|*  
*kuṣṭhavraṇādiśamanaṃ śṛtamājyaṃ sadugdhakam \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. A medicinal Ghrtam cooked with the expressed juice of Kala, Guduci and milk cures cutaneous affections, heat in the body and diseases of the deranged Vayu.

## \|\| 170.41 \|\|

*triphalāguggulurvātaraktamūrchāpahārakaḥ \|*  
*ūrustambhavināśāya gomūtreṇa ca gugguluḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. Triphala taken with Guggula cures epilepsy and Vataraktam; Guggulu taken with cow's urine conquers that form of nervous disease which is known as Urustambha.

## \|\| 170.42-46 \|\|

*śuṇṭhīgokṣurakakvāthaḥ sāmavātārtiśūlanut \|*  
*daśamūlāmṛtairaṇḍarāsnānāgaradārubhiḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

*kvātho hanti māhaśothaṃ marīcaguḍasaṃyutaḥ \|*  
*kāsaghno modakaḥ proktastṛṣṇārocakanāśanaḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

*kaṇṭakāriguḍūcībhyāṃ pṛthak triṃśatpale rase \|*  
*prasthasiddhaṃ ghṛtañcaiva kāsanuddhṛdi dīpanaḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

*kṛṣṇādhātrīsitāśuṇṭhīmarīcasaindhavānvitaḥ \|*  
*kvātha eraṇḍatailena sāmaṃ hantyanilaṃ gurum \|\| 45 \|\|*

*balā punarnavairaṇḍabṛhatīdvayagokṣuraiḥ \|*  
*sahiṅgulavarṇa pītaṃ vātaśūlavimardanam \|\| 46 \|\|*

42-46. A decoction of Dasamula, Goksura, Sunt hi, Eranda, Rasna and Nagara proves curative in Rheumatism and an acting pain in the limbs. A decoction of Vala, Punarnava, Eranda, Vrihatl, Kantakari and Goksura, taken with castoroil, subdues even the most vilurent cases of nervous disorders. A solution of common salt, taken with asafoetida, proves curative in flatulent coilc.

## \|\| 170.47 \|\|

*triphalānimbayaṣṭīkakaṭukāragvadhaiḥ śṛtam \|*  
*pāyayenmadhunā miśraṃ dāhaśūlopaśāntaye \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. An infusion of Triphala, Nimba, Yastika,Katuka and Aragvadha should be given with honey for the alleviation of colic, or of a burning sensation in the body.

## \|\| 170.48 \|\|

*triphalāpaḥ sayaṣṭīkāḥ pariṇāmārtināśanāḥ \|*  
*gomūtraśuddhamaṇḍūraṃ triphalācūrṇasaṃyutam \|*  
*vilihanmadhusarpirbhyāṃ śūlaṃ hanti tridoṣajam \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. Triphala-water taken with Yasthikam cures the type of colic known as Parinama hula. A lambative made of iron-rust purified with cow's urine and Triphalapowder, honey, and clarified butter proves curative in all types of Shula (Gastralgiay.

## \|\| 170.49 \|\|

*trivṛtkṛṣṇāharītakyo dvicatuṣpañcabhāgikāḥ \|*  
*guṭikā guḍatulyāstā viḍvibandhagadāpahāḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. A pill consisting of two parts of Trivrt, four parts of Krsna, and five parts of Haritaki, taken with an equal quantity of treacle, removes constipation of the bowels.

## \|\| 170.50 \|\|

*harītakīyavakṣārapippalītrivṛtastathā \|*  
*ghṛtaiścūrṇamidaṃ peyamudāvartāvināśanam \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. A compound consisting of powdered Haritaki, Yavaksara, Pippall and Trivrt taken with clarified butter proves curative in Udavarta (tympanites with suppression of the stool and urine).

## \|\| 170.51 \|\|

*trivṛddharītakīśyāmāḥ snuhīkṣīreṇa bhāvitāḥ \|*  
*vaṭikā mūtrapītāstāḥ śreṣṭāścānāhabhedikāḥ \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. Pills consisting of Trivrt, powders of Harltaka and Shyama soaked with the expressed juice of Snuhl and then dried in the sun (Bhavita), and taken with cow's urine, forms the best purgative and cures even the worst cases, of Anaha.

## \|\| 170.52 \|\|

*tryūṣaṇatriphalādhanyaviḍaṅgacavyacitrakaiḥ \|*  
*kalkīkṛtairghṛtaṃ siddhaṃ saṃskāraṃ vātagulmanut \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. A medicinal Ghrtam, prepared with a paste of Tryusnam, Triphala, Dhanya, Vidanga, Cavya and Citrakam, and taken with alkali, proves curative in the Vataja form of Gulma.

## \|\| 170.53 \|\|

*mūlaṃ nāgaramānītaṃ sakṣīraṃ hṛdayārtinut \|*  
*sauvacalaṃ tadardhantu śivānāñca ghṛtaṃ pibet \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. Roots of Nagavala taken with milk, as well as Sauvarcala salt taken with half as much of Shiva-Ghrtam should be regarded as a potent cure for all forms of diseases of the heart.

## \|\| 170.54 \|\|

*kaṇāpāṣāṇabhedairvā śilājatukacūrṇakam \|*  
*taṇḍulībhirguḍenāpi mūtrakṛcchrīti jīvati \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. A compound consisting of powdered Капа, Pasanabheda. Ela and 6ilajatu taken with treacle and washings of rice is a potent remedy for all forms of strangury.

## \|\| 170.55 \|\|

*amṛtānāgarīdhātrīvājigandhātrikaṇṭakām \|*  
*prapibedvātaregārtaḥ saśūlo mūtrakṛcchravān \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. A decoction of Amrta, Nagara, Dhatri, Vajigandha and Trikantakam may be given with advantage to patients suffering from strangury, colic, or any disease of the deranged Vayu.

## \|\| 170.56 \|\|

*sitātulyo yavakṣāraḥ sarvakṛcchranivāraṇaḥ \|*  
*nidigdhikāraso vāpi sakṣaudraḥ kṛcchranāśanaḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. Yavaksara (impure carbonate of potash) taken with an equal quantity of sugar is almost a specific for all forms of strangury, in which the expressed juice of Nidigedhika maybe also advantageously taken in combination with honey.

## \|\| 170.57 \|\|

*lavaṇaṃ triphalākalkairmūtrāghātaharaṃ smṛtam \|*  
*mūtre viruddhe karpūracūrṇaṃ liṅge praveśayet \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. Triphala-paste taken with rock salt removes the suppression of urine in which disease a stick of camphor may be introduced into the urethra for inducing the flow.

## \|\| 170.58 \|\|

*kvāthaśca śigrumūlotthaḥ kaṭūṣṇośmānipātanaḥ \|*  
*sarvamehaharodhātryā rasaḥkṣaudraniśāyutaḥ \|*  
*triphalādārudārvyaṣṭakvāthaḥ kṣaudreṇa mehahā \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. Decoctions of 5igru-roots administered like warm lead to the disintegration and falling off of stones in the bladder, or of, urinary concretions. The expressed juice of Dhatri and Nina taken with honey is almost a specific remedy for all forms of urinary complaints (Mehas). A decoction of Triphala, Darn, and Avja taken with honey proves beneficial in all types of Meha.

## \|\| 170.59-61 \|\|

*asvapnaṃ ca vyavāyaṃ ca vyāyāmāścintanāni ca \|*  
*sthaulyamicchanpaparityaktaṃ krameṇābhipravardhayet \|\| 59 \|\|*

*yavaśyāmākabhojī syāsthaulyakṛnmadhuvāriṇā \|*  
*uṣṇamannaṃ samaṇḍaṃ vā pibankṛśatanurbhavet \|\| 60 \|\|*

*sacavyajīrakaṃ vyoṣā hiṅgusauvarcalāmalāḥ \|*  
*madhunā raktavaḥ pītā medhoghnā sarvadīpanāḥ \|\| 61 \|\|*

59-61. Wishing to be stout a person should renounce late hours, sexual congress, physical exercise, and anxiety. Food into the composition of which barley or буатака grains largely enter, as well as sweet drinks contribute to the stoutness of the body. Hot food or hot Manilas, or fried barleypowder taken with honey, or compounds made of Cavya, Rraka, Vyosa, Hingu, Sauvarcala salt and Amala are anti-corpulent in their effects.

## \|\| 170.62 \|\|

*caturguṇe jale mūtre dviguṇe citrakāṇi ca \|*  
*kalkaiḥ siddha ghṛta prasthaṃ sakṣīraṃ jaṭharī pibet \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. A medicinal Ghrtam duly cooked with four times as much water, twice as much Citrakam and Utpalam, and cow's urine should be internally administered to an Ascites patient.

## \|\| 170.63 \|\|

*kramavṛddhyā daśāhāni daśa paippālikaṃ dinam \|*  
*vardhayetpayasā sārdhaṃ tathaivāpānayetpunaḥ \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. Ten Haritakis, successively increased, each day, and taken for ten days with milk, prove curative in Ascites.

## \|\| 170.64 \|\|

*kṣīraṣaṣṭikabhojīsyādevaṃ kṛṣṇasahasrakam \|*  
*bṛṃhaṇaṃ mudgamāyuṣyaṃ plīhodaravināśanam \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. Use of such a thousand Haritakis while living on milk, Yasthika, or rice diet prove curative in dropsy due to splenic enlargement. They are extremely constructive and life prolonging in their efficacy.

## \|\| 170.65 \|\|

*punarnavākvāthakalkaiḥ siddhaṃ śothaharaṃ ghṛtam \|*  
*gāvā matreṇa saṃsevyaṃ pippalī vā payo 'nvitāḥ \|*  
*guḍana vābhayāṃ tulyāṃ viśvaṃ vā śotharogiṇā \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. A medicinal Ghrtam cooked with the admixture of the expressed juice of Punarnava should be regarded as a potent cure for oedema and anasarca.

## \|\| 170.66 \|\|

*tailameraṇḍajaṃ pītvā balāsiddhaṃ payo 'nvitam \|*  
*ādhmānaśūlopacitāmantravṛddhiñjayennaraḥ \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. An oedema or anasarca-patient should do well to take Pippall through the vehicle of milk or cow's urine; or Abhyaya and treacle.

## \|\| 170.67 \|\|

*bhraṣṭorucakatailena kalkaḥ pathyāsamudbhavaḥ \|*  
*kṛṣṇasaindhavasaṃyukto vaddhirogaharaḥ paraḥ \|\| 67 \|\|*

67\. Castor oil, taken with a decoction of Vala cures hernia, attended with distension of the abdomen and an aching pain. Oil of black Uravaka cooked with the paste of Pathya and taken with Krsna and rock salt proves efficacious in Vrddhi Roga.

## \|\| 170.68 \|\|

*nirguṇḍīmūlanasyena gaṇḍamālā vinaśyati \|*  
*smuhīgaṇḍīrikāsvedo nāśayedarbudāni ca \|\| 68 \|\|*

68\. The expressed juice of Nirgundi roots used as an errhine cures Scrofula; fomentations with decoctions of Snuhl and Gambhlrika leads to the resolution of tumours.

## \|\| 170.69-70 \|\|

*hastikarṇapalāśasya galagaṇḍaṃ tu lepataḥ \|*  
*dhattūrairaṇḍanirguṇḍīvarṣābhūśigrusarṣapaiḥ \|\| 69 \|\|*

*pralepaḥślīpadaṃ hanti cirotthamatidāruṇam \|*  
*śobhāñjanakasindhṛtthahiṅguṃ vidradhināśanam \|\| 70 \|\|*

69-70. Plasters of pasted Hastl-Karna and Palasa prove curative in scrofula; plasters composed of Dhatusra, Eranda, Nirgundi, Varsabhu, 6igru and Sarsapa pasted together are known to cure cases of long-standing Elephantiasis. Plasters of Hingu, Shobhanjana and Sindhuttha cure Vidradhis (abcesses).

## \|\| 170.71 \|\|

*śarapuṅkhā madhuyutā yātsarsvavraṇagepaṇī \|*  
*nimbapatrasya vālepaḥ śvayathuvraṇagepaṇaḥ \|\| 71 \|\|*

71\. Plasters of Sarpunkha made with honey bring about the healing of an ulcer; plasters of Nimba leaves its asepcision.

## \|\| 170.72 \|\|

*triphalā khadiro dārvo nyagrodho vraṇaśodhanaḥ \|*  
*sadyaḥ kṣataṃ vraṇaṃ vaidyaḥ saśūlaṃ pariṣecayet \|\| 72 \|\|*

72\. A wise physician should employ a decoction of Triphala, Khadira, DarvI, and Nyagrodha for washing all cuts, ulcers or Sadya Vranas attended with an aching pain.

## \|\| 170.73 \|\|

*yaṣṭīmadhukayuktena kiñciduṣṇena sarpiṣā \|*  
*buddhvāgantuvraṇānvaidyo ghṛtakṣaudrasamanvitām \|\| 73 \|\|*

73\. Plasters of Yasthimadhu mixed with warm clarified butter would prove efficacious in all forms of traumatic ulcers.

## \|\| 170.74-75 \|\|

*śītāṃ kriyāṃ prayuñjīta pittaraktoṣmanāśinīm \|*  
*kvātho vaṃśatvageraṇḍaśvadaṃṣṭravanidākṛtaḥ \|\| 74 \|\|*

*sahiṅgusaindhavaḥ pītaḥ koṣṭhasthaṃ strāvayedasṛk \|*  
*yavakolakulatthānāṃ niḥsnehena rasena vā \|\| 75 \|\|*

74-75. In all traumatic ulcers (cults, wounds, etc.) cooling measures should be at once resorted to for alleviating the heat of the enraged blood and deranged Pittam of the locality, for which purpose the part may be washed with a decoction of Bamboobark, Eranda and 6vadanstra, mixed with honey; a solution of Hingu with rock salt, or a decoction of Nava, Kola, and Kulatha pulse without the addition of Ghrttam, internally administered, lets out the blood incarcerated in any of the wounded Kostas (chambers) or viscera of the body.

## \|\| 170.76 \|\|

*bhuñjītānnaṃ yavāgvā vā pivetsaindhavasaṃyutam \|*  
*karañjāriṣṭanirguṇḍīraso hanyādvraṇakrimīn \|\| 76 \|\|*

76\. Arista (medicated wine) of Karanja, or the expressed juice of Nirgundi proves curative in ulcers and worms in the intestines.

## \|\| 170.77 \|\|

*triphalācūrṇasaṃyukto guggulurvaṭakīkṛtaḥ \|*  
*niryantraṇo vibandhaghno vradhanagepaṇaḥ \|\| 77 \|\|*

77\. Pills made of powdered Triphala and Guggulu remove constipation of the bowels and cure ulcers.

## \|\| 170.78 \|\|

*dūrvāsvarasasiddhaṃ vā talaṃ kampillakena vā \|*  
*dārvotvacaśca kalkena pradhānaṃ vraṇaropaṇam \|\| 78 \|\|*

78\. A medicated oil cooked with the expressed juice of Durva grass, Kampilla, and the paste of Darvitvaca is one of the most potent healing remedies in ulcer cases.

## Chapter 171

## \|\| 171.1 \|\|

*dhanvantariruvāca \|*  
*nāḍīvraṇādirogāṇāṃ cikitsāṃ śṛṇu suśruta \|*  
*nāḍīṃ śastreṇa saṃpāṭya nājīnāṃ vraṇavatkriyā \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Dhanvantari said: — Now hear me, О Susruta, discourse on the nature of the medical treatment to be adopted in cases of sinus. Sinuses should be first opened with the knife, after which remedial measures mentioned in connection with ulcers should be employed.

## \|\| 171.2 \|\|

*guggulutriphalāvyopaiḥ samāṃśairājyayojitaiḥ \|*  
*nāḍīduṣṭavraṇaṃ śūlaṃ bhagandaramatho jayet \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. A medicated Ghrtam cooked with the admixture of Guggula, Triphala, Vyosa and Mansa cures sinus,, fistula in ano, bad or malignant sores, as well as coilc.

## \|\| 171.3 \|\|

*nirguṇḍīrasatastailaṃ nāḍīduṣṭavraṇāpaham \|*  
*hitaṃ pāmāmayānāṃ tu pānābhyañjananāvanaiḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. A medicated oil cooked with the admixture of the expressed juice of Nirgundl cures sinuses, and malignant ulcers; used both internally and externally this oil proves efficacious in Pima.

## \|\| 171.4 \|\|

*gaggutriphalākṛṣṇātripañcaikāṃśayojitā \|*  
*ghuṭi (guḍi) kāśothagulmārśobhagandaravatāṃ hitā \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Pills consisting of three parts of Guggulu, five parts of Triphala, and one part of Krsna prove curative in oedema, intestinal glands, haemorrhoids and fistula in ano.

## \|\| 171.5 \|\|

*dhvajamadhye śirāvedhe viśuddhirupadaṃśake \|*  
*pāko rakṣyaḥ prayatnena śiśrakṣayakaro hi saḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. In cutting of the vein of the penis, as well as in syphilis, suppuration of the sore is to be primarily guarded against in as much as suppuration in these cases may ultimately lead to the sloughing off of the organ.

## \|\| 171.6 \|\|

*paṭolanimbatriphalāguḍūcīkvāthamāpibet \|*  
*sagugguluṃ sakhadiramupadaṃśo vinaśyati \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. A decoction of GuducI, Магаса, Nimba and Patola leaves may be advantageously given with catechu and dellilium in Syphilis.

## \|\| 171.7 \|\|

*dahetkaṭāhe triphalāṃ sāmasī (ṣī) madhasaṃyutām \|*  
*upadaṃśe pralepo 'ya sadyo ropayate vraṇam \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Burn down Triphala to ashes in an iron pan, charred Triphala applied with honey to spyhilitic sores brings about their healing almost that very day.

## \|\| 171.8 \|\|

*triphalānimbabhūnimbakarañjakhadirādibhiḥ \|*  
*kalkaiḥ kvāthairghṛtaṃ pakvamupadaṃśaharaṃ param \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. A medicated Ghrtam cooked with the admixtur of a decoction or paste of Triphala, Nimba, Bhunimba, Karana, and Khadira proves curative in syphilis and in diseases of syphilitic origin.

## \|\| 171.9 \|\|

*ādau bhagnaṃ viditvā tu secayecchītalāṃbunā \|*  
*pakvenālepanaṃ kāryaṃ bandhanaṃ ca kuśānvitam \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. In a case of fracture of the bone, the seat of the fracture should be first ascertained, which should be first washed with cold water then plastered with mire and bound with blades of Kusa grass

## \|\| 171.10 \|\|

*māṣaṃ māṃsaṃ tathā sarpiḥ kṣīraṃ yūṣaḥ satījalaḥ \|*  
*bṛṃhaṇaṃ cānnapānaṃ syātpradeyaṃ bhagnarogiṇe \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. Milk, clarified butter meat-essence, meat- soap of sesame seeds should form the diet of a fracturepatient.

## \|\| 171.11 \|\|

*rasonamadhunāsājyasitākalkaṃ samaśnutā \|*  
*chinnabhinnacyutāsthīnāṃ sandhānamacirādbhavet \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. A patient suffering from the dislocation, fracture, or crushing of any bone would do well to live on a regimen of garlic and fried paddy, mixed with honey and sugar.

## \|\| 171.12 \|\|

*aśvatthatriphalāvyoṣāḥ savarabhiḥ samīkṛtaiḥ \|*  
*tulyo guggulunā yojyo bhagnasandhiprasādha (kṛt) kaḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Take equal parts of Asvattha, Triphala and Vyosa, and Guggulu equal to their combined wieght, and mix. This compound has the virtue of setting broken bones.

## \|\| 171.13 \|\|

*sarvakuṣṭheṣu vamanaṃ recanaṃ raktamokṣaṇa \|*  
*vacāvāsāpaṭolānāṃ nimbasya kalinītvacaḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Bleeding, and use of emetics and purgatives are recommended in all forms of cutaneous affections. A decoction of Vaca, Vasa, Patola, and Nimba, or Phalinibark taken with honey, subdues the deranged Vayu, and is a good constructive remedy.

## \|\| 171.14 \|\|

*kaṣāyo madhunā pīto vātahṛnmadanānvitaḥ \|*  
*virecanaṃ prayoktavyaṃ trivṛtkarṇaphalatrikaiḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. Purgings should be induced with the administration of a compund of Trivrt, Danti and Triphala.

## \|\| 171.15 \|\|

*manaḥ śilāṃmarīcaistu tailaṃ kuṣṭhavināśanam \|*  
*sarvakuṣṭhe vilepo 'yaṃ śivāpañcaguḍaudanam \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. A medicated oil cooked with, the admixture of realgar and black pepper proves efficacious in all forms of cutaneous affections, and plasters composed of these two drugs may be used in all forms of Kustha (skin disease) with advantage in which the patient should take every day five Myrobalans in combination with treacle.

## \|\| 171.16 \|\|

*karañjailagajaiḥ kuṣṭhaṃ gomūtreṇa pralepataḥ \|*  
*karavīrodvartanaṃ ca tailāktasya ca kuṣṭhahṛt \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. Plasters composed of Karanja, Tagara, and Kustham pasted together with cow's urine, and rubbing of the affected part with Karavira after anointing it, prove curative in cutaneous affections.

## \|\| 171.17-18 \|\|

*haridrā malayaṃ rāsnā guḍūcyeḍagajastathā \|*  
*āragvadhaḥ karañjaśca lepaḥ kuṣṭhaharaḥ paraḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

*manaḥ śilāviḍaṅgāni vāgajī sarṣapāstathā \|*  
*karañjairmūtrapiṣṭo 'yaṃ lepaḥ kuṣṭaharor'kavat \|\| 18 \|\|*

17-18. Similarly, plasters composed of Haridra, Malaym, Rasna, Guduci, Tagara, Aragbadha and Karanja, or of realgar, Vidanga, Vaguji, Karaja and Sarsapa, pasted together with cow's urine, destroys cutaneous affections as the sun destroys darkness.

## \|\| 171.19-20 \|\|

*viḍaṅgaiḍavacā kuṣṭhaniśāsindhūtthasarṣapaiḥ \|*  
*mūtrāmlapiṣṭo lepo 'yaṃ dadrūkuṣṭavināśanaḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

*prapunnāṭasubījāni dhātrī sarjarasaḥ snuhī \|*  
*sauvīrapiṣṭaṃ dadrūṇāmetadudvartanaṃ param \|\| 20 \|\|*

19-20. A plaster composed of Vidanga, Airagaja, Kustha, Nisa and Sindhuttha pasted together with cow's urine cures Ring-worm. Plasters composed of Prapunnat-seeds, Dhatri, Sarjjrasa and Sunhl pasted together with Sauvlra wine may be advantageously used in rubbing the patches in cases of Ring-worm.

## \|\| 171.21 \|\|

*āragvadhasya patrāṇi āranālena peṣayet \|*  
*dadrūkiṭṭima (bha) kuṣṭhāni hanti sidhmānameva ca \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. Plasters composed of Aragavadha leaves pasted with Aranalam proves curative in ringworms; keloid tumours, and psoriasis.

## \|\| 171.22 \|\|

*uṣṇo pītā vāgujī ca kuṣṭhajitkṣīrabhojanaḥ \|*  
*tilājyatriphalākṣaudravyoṣabhallātaśarkarāḥ \|*  
*vṛṣyāḥ sapta samā medhyāḥ kaṣṭhahāḥ kāmacāriṇaḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. A compound to Tilam, Triphala, Vyosa, Bhallataka, sugar, honey and clarified butter taken in equal parts, is highly possessed of constructive and aphrodisiac properties, which may be given with benefit to patients, suffering from any form of cutaneous affections.

## \|\| 171.23 \|\|

*viḍaṅgatriphalākṛṣṇācūrṇaṃ līḍhaṃ samākṣikam \|*  
*hanti kuṣṭhakrimimehanāḍīvraṇabhagandarān \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. A lambative consisting of Vidanga, Triphala, and Krsna pounded and pasted together with honey covers urinary complaints (mehas), skin diseases, intestinal worms, sinuses, and fistula in ano within the range of its therapeutic application.

## \|\| 171.24 \|\|

*yaḥ khādedabhayāriṣṭamariṣṭāmalakāniśāḥ \|*  
*sa jayetsarvakuṣṭhānimāsādūrdhvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. He who takes Abhayaristam (urine of Myrobalan), or Amalaka and Nisa for a month, is sure toget rid of all kinds of skin deseases. Burn to ashes the sprouts of Amra and Khadira trees in an iron pot.

## \|\| 171.25 \|\|

*dahyamānāyutaḥ kumbhe mūlage khadirāṅkuraḥ \|*  
*sākṣadhātrīrasaḥ kṣaudro hanyātkuṣṭhaṃ rasāyanam \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. Ashes thus prepared together with powders of Aksa, taken through the medium of honey and the expressed juice of Dhatri, proves curative in all forms of cutaneous affections. This medicine is also posessed of a good rejuvenating efficacy.

## \|\| 171.26 \|\|

*dhātrī khadirayoḥ kkāthaṃ pītvā vāgajisaṃyutam \|*  
*śaṅkhendudhavalaṃ śvitraṃ hanti tūrṇaṃ na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. A decoction of Dhatri and Khadira taken with Valguja speedily cures even the most obestinate type of leucoderma.

## \|\| 171.27 \|\|

*pītvā bhallātakaṃ tailaṃ māsādvyādhiṃ jayennaraḥ \|*  
*sevitaṃ khādiraṃ vāri pānādyaiḥ kuṣṭhajidbhavet \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. Oil of Bhallataka taken for a month cures all forms of leprosy; solution of catechu taken every day with food or drink cures all forms of skindiseases.

## \|\| 171.28-30 \|\|

*bhāvitaṃ malapūkvāthaiḥ somarājīphalaṃ bahu \|*  
*karṣaṃ bhakṣedalavaṇo hyakṣaphalguśṛtaṃ pibet \|\| 28 \|\|*

*hanti śvitramasādhyaṃ ca lepe yojyāparājitā \|*  
*vāsā śuddhā ca triphalā paṭolaṃ ca karañjakam \|\| 29 \|\|*

*nimbāśanaṃ kṛṣṇavetraṃ kvāthakalkena yaddhṛtam \|*  
*vajrakaṃ tadbhavetkuṣṭhaṃ śatavarṣāṇi jīvati \|\| 30 \|\|*

28-30. A medicated Ghrtam cooked with a decoction and paste of VW, GuducI, Triphala, Patolam, Karanjakam, Nimba, Asanam, and Krsna Vetaram proves curative in all forms of skin diseases, and enables its users to live up to a hundred years. This Ghrtam is called Vajrakam Ghrtam.

## \|\| 171.31 \|\|

*svarasena ca dūrvāyāḥ pacettailaṃ caturguṇam \|*  
*kacchūrvicarcikā pāmā abhyaṅgādeva naśyati \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. Take the expressed juice of Durva grass and four times as much oil, cook it in the usual officinial method; external applications of this oil cures itches, Pama. etc.

## \|\| 171.32-33 \|\|

*drumatvagarkakuṣṭhāni lavaṇāni ca mūtrakam \|*  
*gambhārikācitrakaistaistailaṃ kuṣṭhavraṇādinut \|\| 32 \|\|*

*(athāmlapittacikitsā) dhātrīnimbaphalaṃ tadvadgomūtreṇa ca citrakam \|*  
*vāsāmṛtāparpaṭikānimbabhūnimbamārkaraiḥ (vaiḥ) \|*  
*triphalākulatthaiḥ kvāthaḥ sakṣaudraścāmlapittahā \|\| 33 \|\|*

32-33. An oil duly cooked and prepared in combination with Druma-bark, Tvak, Trka, Kunt ham, rock salt, Gamblrika, and cow's urine proves curative in ulcers and skin diseases. A decoction composed of Vasa, Amrta, Parpatakam, Nimba, Bhonimba, Markara, Triphala, and Kulattha pulse, taken with honey, cures Amlapittam (acidity).

## \|\| 171.34 \|\|

*phalatrikaṃ paṭolaṃ ca tiktakvāthaḥ sitāyutaḥ \|*  
*pīto yaṣṭīmadhuyuto jvaracchardyamlapittajit \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. A decoction to Triphala, Patolam, and Tikta, taken with sugar and Yastimadhu cures fever, vomiting and acidity.

## \|\| 171.35 \|\|

*vāsāghṛtaṃ tiktaghṛtaṃ pippalīghṛtameva ca \|*  
*amlapitte prayoktavyaṃ guḍakūṣmāṇḍakaṃ tathā \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. Visa-Ghrtam, Tikta-Ghrtam, Pippali- Ghrtam and Guda-Kusmandam should be employed in Amlapitam.

## \|\| 171.36 \|\|

*pippalī madhusaṃyuktā amlapittavināśinī \|*  
*śleṣmāgnimāndyanutpathyāpippalīguḍamodakaḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. Pippali taken with honey cures acidity a confection made of Pathya, and treacle conquers impaired digestion and disases of the deranged Kapham.

## \|\| 171.37 \|\|

*piṣṭvājājīṃ sadhanyākāṃ ghṛprasthaṃ vipācayet \|*  
*kaphapittāruciharaṃ mandānalavamiṃ haret \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. Cook a Ghrtam in the usual way with a paste of Ajali, and and Dhanyakam, This Ghrtam cures impate digestion with a non-relish for food, as well as vomiting and diseases of the deranged Pittam and Kapham.

## \|\| 171.38-39 \|\|

*(ityamlapittacikitsā) pippalyamṛtabhūnimbavāsakāriṣṭaparpaṭaiḥ \|*  
*khadirāriṣṭakaiḥ kvātho visphoṭārtijvarāpahaḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

*triphalārasasaṃyuktaṃ sarpistrivṛtayāsaha \|*  
*prayoktavyaṃ virekārthaṃ vīsarpajvaraśāntaye \|\| 39 \|\|*

38-39. A decoction of Pippali, Amrta, Bhunimba, Vasaka, Arista. Parpata and Khadira proves curative in carbuncles with fever. Clarified butter in admixture with the expressed juice (Rasa) of Triphala and Trivrt should be given as a purgative in Erysipelas with fever.

## \|\| 171.40 \|\|

*khādirātriphalāriṣṭapaṭolāmṛtavāsakaiḥ \|*  
*kvātho 'ṣṭakākhyo jayati romāntikamasūrikām \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. A decoction of Khadira, Triphala Arista, Patolam, Amrta, and Vasaka, proves curative in measles and small pox.

## \|\| 171.41 \|\|

*kuṣṭhavīsarpavisphoṭakaṇḍvādīnāṃ vighātakaḥ \|*  
*laśunānāṃ tu cṛrṇasya gharṣo maśakanāśanaḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. Dusting of the affected part with garlic- powder proves beneficial in carbuncles, Erysipelas, itches, Masaka and other cutaneous affections.

## \|\| 171.42 \|\|

*carmakīlaṃ jarumaṇiṃ maśakāṃstilakālakān \|*  
*utkṛtya śastreṇa dahetkṣāgagnibhyāmaśeṣataḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. In Carmakllas. Jarumanis, Маsака (described before) the affected part should be first scarified and then cauterised with fire or alkali.

## \|\| 171.43 \|\|

*paṭolanīlīlepaḥ syājjāla (jvālā) gardabharoganut \|*  
*guñjāphalaiḥ śṛtaṃ talaṃ bhṛṅgarājarasena tu \|*  
*kaṇṭha (ṇḍu) dāruṇakṛtkuṣṭhavātavyādhivināśanam \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. Plasters composed of Nfli, and Patola leaves cures Pashana-Gardhava (parotitis) oil cooked with Gunja berries and the expressed juice of Bhrngaraja cures the from of cutaneous affection known as Kapala Kustham.

## \|\| 171.44 \|\|

*arkāsthimajjātriphalānālīchā bhṛṅgarājakam \|*  
*jīrṇe pakve lauhacūrṇaṃ kāñjikaṃ kṛṣṇakeśakṛt \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. A compound consisting of the inner pulps of mango stones, Triphala, Nila, Bhrhgaja, Kandupaka and iron dust mixed with Kanjika imparts a black gloss to grey hair.

## \|\| 171.45 \|\|

*kṣīrātsaśarkarasāddviprastho madhukātpale \|*  
*tailamya kuḍavaṃ pakvaṃ tannasyaṃ palitāpaham \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. Cook a Kudava measure of oil with two Prastha measures of the expressed juice of Parna leaves, milk, 19 and Arka. The oil thus prepared removes the greyness of hairs even of old men.

## \|\| 171.46 \|\|

*mukharoge tu triphalāgaṇḍūṣaparidhāraṇam \|*  
*gṛhadhūma yavakṣārapāṭhāvyoparasāñjanam \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. Gargles of Triphala-decoction, or of one consisting of chamber soot, nitrate of potash, Patha, Byosa, and Rasanjanam should be held in the mouth in stomatitis and affections of the mouth.

## \|\| 171.47-48 \|\|

*tejodaṃ triphalālodhraṃ citrakaṃ ceti cūrṇitam \|*  
*sakṣaudraṃ dhārayedvaktre grīvādantāsyaroganut \|\| 47 \|\|*

*paṭola nimbajamvvāgramālatīnavapallavāḥ \|*  
*pañcapallavakaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ kaṣayo mukhadhāvane \|\| 48 \|\|*

47-48. Honey saturated with powders of Lodhra, Triphala, and Citrakam, held in the mouth, cures diseases of the throat and the teeth. Gargles consisting of a decoction of the five astringent leaves viz., Leaves of Patola, Nimba, Jamvira, Amra, and Malati, should be regarded as the best in diseases of the mouth.

## \|\| 171.49 \|\|

*laśunārdrakaśigrūṇāṃ pārulyā mūlakasya ca \|*  
*rudantyāśca rasaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ kaduṣṇaḥ karṇapūraṇe \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. The expressed juice of Lacuna, Ardrakam, 6igru, Parula, Mulakam or Kadali, administered luke worm, forms the best ear-drop in Otalgia.

## \|\| 171.50 \|\|

*tīvraśūlottare karṇe saśabde kledavāhini \|*  
*bastamūtraṃ kṣipetkoṣṇaṃ saindhavenāvacūrṇitam \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. In acute Otitis, attended with noise in the ears and a shiny discharge, the expressed juice of Snuhl should be poured into the tympanum, after dusting it with powdered rocksalt.

## \|\| 171.51 \|\|

*jātīpatrarase tailaṃ pakvaṃ pūtikakarṇajit \|*  
*śuṇṭhītailaṃ sārṣapaṃ ca kroṣṇaṃ syātkarṇaśūlanut \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. Oil cooled with the expressed juice of Jatipatram, as well as Shunthi-oil, or warm mustard oil proves most efficacious in relieving earache.

## \|\| 171.52 \|\|

*pañcamūliśṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ syāccitrakaharītakī \|*  
*sarpirguḍaḥ ṣaḍaṅgaścayūṣaḥ pīnasaśāntaye \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. Milk cooked in combination with the drugs of the Pancamula group, as well as a compound of Citraka, Haritald, and treacle, or a Sadanga soup (yusa) proves curative in cases of catarrh.

## \|\| 171.53 \|\|

*akṣikukṣibhavā rogāḥ pratiśyāyavraṇajvarāḥ \|*  
*pañcaite pañcarātreṇa praśamaṃ yānti laṅghanāt \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. By taking a light diet (lit. fasting) for five days in succession a man can get rid of the disorders of digestion, catarrh, fever, ulcer and inflammatory diseases of the eyes.

## \|\| 171.54 \|\|

Vyosa, Sigru, Melaka, Devadaru, Kustakam, Laguna, Valguja-phala, Musta, Guggulu, and Langali, are pungent, appetising, cleanse the system of the morbific diatheses (6odhI, it may also mean laxative) and conquer itches, skindisease and the deranged Kapham.
